notes.title: Into the Bunker Update
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33747333/49cb3bb5b5b5ef9ee5ff7c9d4193b12b6c28db9e.png"][/img][/p][p][u][b]NEW FEATURES[/b][/u] [/p][p][b]Traitor Abilities:[/b] We added the ability for the crafting table and chest in the Cabin to be poisoned. [/p][p][b]New Item: Disintegrator![/b] Traitors can now craft a new item called the Disintegrator with traitor credits and either use it on the objective or attach it to another player. When a player uses a disintegrator on the objective or a player who has a disintegrator attached to them interacts with the objective, a random amount (within a small range) of resources in the objective are destroyed. [/p][p] [/p][p][u][b]BALANCING / IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/u] [/p][list][*][p]We adjusted the Traitor Crate loot tables and increased the cost of opening bunkers. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]To address some player concerns regarding objective messaging, we have updated our UI to include the objective resources needed and the current completion percentage of the objective.  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]When items are dropped, they will no longer roll around and instead will immediately transition to their pickupable state as soon as they hit the ground. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]When players are moving items between inventories and containers, moving an item outside of the container and inventory UI drops that item on the ground. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]To better communicate how to do charge attacks, players will now see a tooltip providing guidance on how to charge their attack. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p] When players are experiencing a cold effect (e.g. when a blizzard hits), we have added an icy vignette to better message that players are being affected by the cold. [/p][/*][/list][p]   [/p][p][b] [u]BUG FIXES[/u][/b] [/p][list][*][p]We made several fixes / changes to address issues where some players were getting disconnected from the game.  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]We fixed an issue where a bear that should have been present in the Upirngivik tile was missing. He is now ready to chase and kill any who come close! [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]We fixed an issue where the pickup timer for ghost players wasn’t displaying.  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where players would sometimes see their fist clipping into their own heads when attempting to punch.  [/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][u][b]COSMETICS[/b][/u] [/p][p]This patch includes changes to support new cosmetics. [/p]

notes.title: Relax Or Die Update
notes.notes: [p]Hey Survivors![/p][p][/p][h3]The Relax Or Die Update is now live![/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33747333/d2869625048efd66854fbcb7a8d1832a9f47352e.png"][/img][/p][h2]NEW FEATURES[/h2][list][*][p]NEW MAP! We have a new map called “Beaver Dam” which features beavers who will slap their tails and dive in the water when you get too close! This map will be playable in both Normal Mode and Customs! [/p][/*][/list][h2]BALANCING / IMPROVEMENTS[/h2][list][*][p]A lobby will now be highlighted in the lobby list if there is a player in that lobby that you have blocked or been blocked by.  [/p][/*][*][p]The Recently Met list will now include all players you’ve come in contact with while in a lobby, even if you didn’t play a game with that player.  [/p][/*][*][p]We made changes to the throwing mechanic so that throwing items feel more intuitive and players can better understand the path a thrown object will take. [/p][/*][*][p]Dropped items will now immediately transition to a pickup-able state and will no longer roll around on the ground before being picked up. [/p][/*][*][p]There is no longer a timer when picking items up off the ground; instead, they will immediately move to your inventory when interacted with. [/p][/*][*][p]When players are dragging-and-dropping items between containers and their inventory, dragging an item outside of the container or inventory UI will now drop the item on the ground. [/p][/*][/list][h2]BUG FIXES[/h2][list][*][p]We fixed an issue where some cosmetics were appearing invisible to other players or yourself. [/p][/*][*][p]We fixed several issues on multiple maps where rocks were floating, trees or consoles were blocking entrances to bunkers, etc.  [/p][/*][*][p]We fixed an issue where roles that are specific to Custom games only were shown in the Roles list of Normal Mode games. [/p][/*][*][p]We fixed an issue where the last button on the Penguin Pajama cosmetic would stretch when the player moves. The button is now firmly in place. [/p][/*][/list][h2]OTHER CHANGES[/h2][list][*][p]We updated our rating in Australia to “M” as per IARC changes. [/p][/*][*][p]We updated our logo on the splash screen to our new logo. [/p][/*][/list][h2]COSMETICS & PROGRESSION TREES[/h2][list][*][p]This patch includes changes to support new cosmetics and progression tree(s).[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 2025 Roadmap Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33747333/fb057cb5873ced596436f9b20bf2146da7074dac.png[/img]

Hey there, Project Winter Community! Sam here, Sr. Producer for Project Winter 👋 

As most of you know, we released a community survey back in January. We received over 1000 responses in both English and Chinese. From the bottom of my heart, I'd like to thank everyone for taking the time to answer our questions and provide us with your thoughts. We have taken the last ~2 months to aggregate, translate, and sort through all the responses, and have made some decisions regarding the future of Project Winter, specifically our plans for 2025. 

We would like to make sure that all new and existing players know - and truly [i]feel [/i]- that we, as Developers, are committed to making sure Project Winter continues to live and thrive. As a result of this endeavor, I have a 2025 roadmap that we'd like to share with everyone. We are calling this our "Road to Project Winter v2.0". I want to be crystal-clear that this is not a sequel to Project Winter, but rather, a refreshed Project Winter experience. 

We will not be releasing specifics about any of the items on the roadmap - we want to surprise you with each content update / release - [i]but [/i]we do want to show you what we're working on! 

We are planning the following changes to be released this year:
[list]
[*] We will release at least 2 new maps
[*] Lobby hosts will be able to select what map to play next
[*] Gondola map is coming back to Normal mode!
[*] We are removing both the Ally role and Wild Spirit (ghost bear) from Normal modes
[*] We will be releasing something we are code-naming "Cabin Fever" (no details about this will be announced, so don't ask 
[/list]

In addition to all of the above changes, we will also be making a ton of balancing changes to in-game messaging, items, inventory management, player block function, the Store, and the HUD/UI. We will also be adding a new throwing mechanic! 

We are very excited for what the year has in store for us and for the community, and we hope you will love everything when it is released!

notes.title: Wilderness Wardrobe Update
notes.notes:
The Wilderness Wardrobe Update Is Now Live!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33747333/4e98d7dc5067bc2237479163f3b0583ea500c246.png[/img]
We’re excited to announce that our latest update is now live! This release focuses on refining your gameplay experience with a range of quality-of-life changes, bug fixes, and some key balancing adjustments.

[b]Welcome New Players! [/b]
A warm welcome to all our new players who’ve recently joined the community! We’re thrilled to have you on board. Demo mode is now back online, so if you’re looking to explore the game with friends, it’s a great (and free) way to get a feel for everything we have to offer.

[b]Balancing & Improvements[/b]

[b]Abandoned Ranger[/b]
[list]
[*] The Abandoned Ranger objective has now been added to Normal games. Previously, this was only available in Custom games.
[*] We’ve rebalanced the sabotaging mechanics. Signal Boosters that have been sabotaged will now require players to gather a small number of resources to repair them.
[/list]
[b]Wild Spirit[/b]
[list]
[*] To prevent exploits, the Wild Spirit ability can no longer be used immediately in front of entrances or buildings. However, be aware that a transformed bear might still block these entrances!
[*] Traitor Items
[/list]
[b]Traitor Crates[/b]
[list]
[*] The spawn rate of energy drinks in Traitor Crates has been increased.
[/list]
[b]Objectives & Armory[/b]
[list]
[*] We’ve increased the difficulty of the Smoke Signal, Repair, and Stockpile objectives.
[*] The probability of different items, including guns, spawning in armory crates has also been adjusted.
[*] Cosmetics
[/list]

[b]Cosmetics[/b]
[list]
[*] New cosmetics are now available in-store for September, along with additions to our permanent Store collection.
[/list]

[b]Notable Bug Fixes [/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed various issues with snowshoes, ensuring they are consumed correctly and updating their description to reflect that they leave no snow trail. 
[*] Corrected an issue where Traitors were unable to open bunkers with Traitor Credits. 
[*] The Ally role description has been updated to correctly state that the Ally Player can take on multiple roles, not just survivor. 
[*] Corrected the sickle skin's range, ensuring it matches the default sickle. 
[/list]
Full Update Notes ➞ https://projectwinter.co/updates/

notes.title: Beware Lamps Update!
notes.notes:
Hey Survivors! 

They Beware Lamps update is now live! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33747333/d760f811a4bd8d68071d7b50c464840682b3833c.png[/img]

This update focuses primarily on quality-of-life changes, balancing and bug fixes as we continue work on reworking custom games.  

[b]Balance Changes[/b]

[u]Abandoned Ranger
[/u]
[list]
[*] Based on feedback from the community, we reviewed and rebalanced the animal waves for the Abandoned Ranger objective. There is now updated logic for how many and what type of animal will spawn based on the state (sabotaged vs not sabotaged) and how many survivors are still alive. 
[/list]

[b]Some notable bug fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where animal waves would not begin after a signal tower was sabotaged. Now, animal waves will spawn for one minute if the signal tower is reactivated via sabotage.   
[*] Fixed an issue with the Abandoned Ranger objective where animal spawn radius for the signal towers; previously the radius was very small, so animal waves would only spawn if you were very, very close to the signal tower.   
[*] Fixed an issue in Custom Games where the game settings may become desynchronized across players if the host changed the setting in the lobby. This would have caused players to see different objectives and roles from the host. This may have also caused loading issues where some players may have experienced a ‘hang’ while loading into the match.   
[*] Fixed an issue in Custom Games where the match may fail to load if the host modified the animal health values.  
[/list] 

[b]Cosmetics[/b]

As always, you will see new cosmetics in-store for the months of July and August!   

Full update notes ➞ https://projectwinter.co/updates/

notes.title: Time For Cake Update
notes.notes:
Hey Survivors! 

[b]The Time For Cake update is now live! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33747333/79e22d4e5dbfd311d68fc155e32ff33ded36c75b.png[/img]

This update focuses on some quality of life, balancing improvements and bug fixes. 

[b]New Features: [/b]
[u]Lobby Codes [/u]
[list]
[*] To streamline matchmaking, we have added a lobby code function, which will replace lobby passwords. Now, when a player wants to join a lobby, they will need to ask for the lobby code (visible to the lobby host) and enter that code to join the lobby. 
[/list]
[u]
Store Improvements [/u]
[list]
[*] We added a feature where the cosmetic name will appear below the player mannequin / preview in the Store page. 
[/list]
[u]New Hair Colors [/u]
[olist]
[*] We added new default hair colors: light ash blonde, ash blonde, light red, brown, java brown, charcoal black, and dark grey. This brings the total default hair colors to 15 (plus any hair dyes you have purchased). 
[/olist]
[b]Balance Changes: [/b]
[u]Sound Emitter [/u]
[list]
[*] Sound Emitter now allows the user to choose which sounds are played. 
[/list]
Wild Spirit 
[list]
[*] Decreased health of the ghost bear to 800 
[*] Decreased the damage of Roar attack to 80 
[*] Increased the cooldown of Roar attack to 40 seconds 
[*] Decreased the damage of Claw attack to 50 
[/list]
Other Balancing Changes 
[list]
[*] Reverted the 2nd Traitor Drop to be time-based. Previously, both Traitor Airdrops were awarded to Traitors after objective completion. This provided little to no time for Traitors to access and benefit from the second Traitor airdrop. We changed this so that the second Traitor Airdrop is awarded once a set amount of time has passed . 
[/list]

With the release of this update, we'll continue to monitor feedback on Wild Spirit over the next few days before making additional changes.

Full update notes ➞ https://projectwinter.co/updates/

notes.title: The Egg Hunt Update
notes.notes:
The Egg Hunt Update is now live!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33747333/1749a64a1a8db2c4abff9b5653993b93b011b574.png[/img]

This update focuses on an overhaul of our Artifact store, as well as significant changes to the Ally and Wild Spirit features from the previous update. Additionally, we’ve added a new objective available in custom games called “Abandoned Ranger”.


Artifact Store: The store page of the main menu has received a face lift!
[list]
[*] Additional support for new cosmetic categories, allowing us to do “Daily”, “Weekly” or other faster rotations of store items.
[*] Improved the visibility of cosmetic items on display in the store by increasing their image size.
[*] Added the ability to sell cosmetics for Survivor Points
[*] Cosmetic Name will now be displayed when viewing the item in the store.
[/list]
Drops / Crates Page: We’ve introduced a new “Drops Catalog” that allows players to view the contents of a crate before purchasing it.
Abandoned Ranger: We’ve added a new objective to the custom game mode!
[list]
[*] Abandoned Ranger is a new objective where a ranger-style escape vehicle has been abandoned and survivors must repair it.
[*] While repairing it, a signal will begin emitting from it. Signal Boosters around the map will start picking up that signal and transmit a radio frequency that blocks the cabin radio from being able to contact their escape vehicle. 
[*] Players need to locate both signal towers and work to stop the frequency from transmitting. 
[*] This objective is ONLY available in custom game mode as we look for feedback and continue to improve it before we add it to the main game modes.
[/list]
Added Easter event consisting of a progression tree and new store cosmetics.

But wait, more notable changes include:

Ally balance changes:
[list]
[*] There is now a delay before the Ally knows who their Allied Player is.
[*] An ally can be on any team (Survivor, Traitor, or Neutral)
[/list]
Wild Spirit Changes:
[list]
[*] There is now a cooldown for the roar attack
[*] Ghosts no longer accrue Ghost Power while transformed into a ghost bear
[*] There is now a 180 second cooldown between Wild Spirit transformations
[*] Voice chat is muted for the ghost bear while using Wild Spirit ability
[*] And more!
[/list]
Tranquilizer gun has been fixed
[list]
[*] Players now deal the correct amount of damage when suffering from the tranquilized effect
[/list]
Full update notes ➞ https://projectwinter.co/updates/

This is the second update for those who were betrayed or found our winter world too tough. Here's what's coming to make things better in the afterlife:


[list]
[*] Wild Spirit - As a ghost, players can take revenge on their killer by transforming into the wild spirit of a bear!

Unleash your wild spirit with Cupids Chaos!

notes.title: Ghosts of Winter - Part 1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33747333/2ec5cd8ddfe8c19591b076b21974980a0abd8563.png[/img]

🎄🔪 Stabby Holidays Survivors! 🎄🔪

The festive season has sprinkled its magic on Project Winter, bringing back our mischievous elves with the first of several updates to enhance the post-death festivities!

👻 Ghosts of Winter - Part 1 is now live! 👻

This spirited update is dedicated to the backstabbed survivors, terminated traitors, and those who found our winter wonderland a bit too challenging. Here's what's in store to add some cheer to the afterlife:

[list]
[*] Ghostly Event Voting - Even in the afterlife, your voice matters! Dead players can now vote for the global events that living players experience.
[*] Ghostly Item Usage - Ghosts now have an expanded arsenal including smoke bombs, flares, tripwires, and, of course, poison. Time to haunt with style!
[*] Ghost Power - The ghost ability system has been reworked to allow for additional ability uses over time.
[/list]

But that's not all! We've wrapped up some extra goodies for you:

[list]
[*] Snowmen now drop throwable snowballs for a little harmless fun with your friends.
[*] Overhauled Bonus Challenges so that players can now complete multiple challenges in a single match. 
[*] Each completed challenge will grant a player a small stat buff.
[*] Added Holiday 2023 Progression Tree, weekly challenges, and a sackful of cosmetics to make your winter wardrobe sparkle.
[*] Increased the number of Blackout DLC tokens to 2 so that players who do not own the DLC can play more Blackout matches per day.
[/list]

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a few issues where key bindings weren't displaying correctly.
[*] Fixed an issue where some previous login and progression rewards were not displaying in the correct order.
[*] Fixed an issue where players who had a fifth inventory slot (gained after crafting a backpack) were not able to select the third or fourth inventory slots.
[*] Fixed an issue where players could lose controller navigation abilities after purchasing specific cosmetics in the Limited Time store.
[*] Fixed an issue where tool tips would not show for ghost abilities on the inventory/ability bar.
[*] Fixed an issue where ghosts using a controller, were unable to correctly see tooltip information when pressing the up button.
[*] Fixed an issue where players were experiencing difficulty navigating timeline events using a mouse and keyboard. 
[*] Fixed an issue where some Titles had "(Title)" appended to them.
[*] Fixed an issue where some players were seeing duplicate titles.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Progression list wasn’t scrollable; we made some UI adjustments to support being able to have a scrollable list so players can see the entire list. 
[*] Fixed some spelling errors in progression tree items; we have turned on spell check going forward.
[*] Fixed an issue where a tree was too close to the Smoke Signal objective on the Blackout map. We thought you might like to get to the objective without the tree blocking you, so we moved the tree.
[*] Fixed a few environmental issues that would cause players to become stuck in different spots, be able to walk on things they shouldn’t, or clip into areas on various maps.
[*] Fixed an issue where a bear explored a little too far and found himself stuck on a cliff. We also had a wolf who got a little ambitious and got stuck on some rocks, so we helped him break free, too! There were a few wolves who would get stuck in the Portal escape, too, so we chatted with them and let them know they didn’t need to stop there anymore.
[*] Fixed an issue where some animals got a little too thirsty, and decided they’d spawn in the water.
[*] Fixed an issue where some rocks near the escape on Blackout were fading to a light grey color. We’ve had a stern discussion with them and now they will remain the correct color. 
[*] Fixed an issue where using ice bombs were very, very bright in Blackout. 
[*] Fixed an issue where we got a little ambitious with the snow and buried a sign. We chopped it up and got rid of it as it was right beside a sign that we didn’t bury in snow! 
[*] Fixed an issue where the helipad entered a separate dimension and let thrown items pass through it. 
[*] Fixed an issue on the Deep Woods map where animals would not attack players if they found the sweet spot between the cave and the ice wall.
[*] Fixed an issue where thrown melee weapons would get stuck on top of the animal wave objective.
[*] Fixed an issue with hatch positions on the Beach map; we made them to be more useful and make actual sense.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Tarot Eye cosmetic didn’t have a consistent glow.
[*] Fixed a few issues where some cosmetics were clipping into each other or not appearing correctly on certain body models. 
[*] Fixed an issue where some weapon skins would display with their Halloween event skins during Mass Hysteria event; we fixed this so you can still be anonymous and suspicious.
[*] Fixed some issues on the Match Over Timeline screen where images were broken, icons aren't appearing correctly, or events were missing. 
[*] Fixed some issues with Custom Games where objectives were de-sync’d under very specific scenarios.
[*] Fixed some issues where Steam inventory items, titles, badges were not displaying their images correctly.
[*] Fixed an issue where proximity chat decided it didn’t want to work once a survivor crafted a radio.
[*] Fixed an issue where badges and titles relating to commendations were only updating after relaunching the game; this has been fixed so you’ll see your progress after the match.
[/list]

notes.title: 4 years in review
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33747333/4ac6c03ae2034cc9514fa2d0cdb4f22d66a4de32.png[/img]

Hello Survivors!

As part of our anniversary we set out to gather some fun statistics from the profile tab to present to you all!

While we found that you are all pretty good Survivors, having [b]escaped 7 million times[/b], not all survivors are equally cooperative. 

One player in particular has left their team behind to [b]take the Escape Pod almost 500 times[/b], in contrast to another player who has singlehandedly [b]called the escape almost 5,000 times[/b]!

In terms of animals killed, there is clearly some bias going on, as you have [b]killed twice as many Wolves as you have Moose.[/b] 
In total brutally [b]murdering 44 million animals[/b] for food, hide, loot, or just prestige. This is almost [b]15 times animals killed[/b] as there are wolves, bears, and moose [b]still alive combined[/b]; but you don't stop there, [b]cutting down 80 million trees[/b] and [b]gathering over 132 million berries[/b]. After all this environmental damage, you have headed back into the cabin to [b]cook 113 million items[/b]!

In a game of deception, you all know that not everyone can be trusted. In total you have all [b]used 1 million truth serums[/b] trying to figure out who the real Traitor is - one player alone having [b]killed 9 thousand Traitors[/b]. As a result, Traitors have resorted to surviving in the wilderness where they've [b]opened 45 million Traitor Crates[/b] and [b]sabotaged 2 million objectives[/b].

In the end, you've all played [b]3 million[/b] games and collectively [b]walked further than the distance to Saturn[/b], which we are so grateful for! 

Thank you for the past 4 years of funny moments and laughs!

Stay warm, Survivors!

[b]ToxMod Trial update:[/b]

We've decided not to use ToxMod within Project Winter at this time. It has been disabled in our backend and the related code will be removed in a future update.

We love working with Modulate, and ToxMod is an excellent tool for finding blatantly toxic players and has a bright future ahead. That said, after reviewing what it found during the trial, we've noticed that the reporting system we had in place was more efficient for our team size and the needs of our community.

We're still passionate about solving these issues when they arise, but this glimpse into the broader statistics for Project Winter has given us confidence that our pre-existing approaches have been working reasonably well.

We will explore additional options to keep our community safe, fun, and hate-free. In the meantime, please keep reporting bad eggs you encounter both from within the game and to us directly on our discord: www.discord.gg/projectwinter.

We’ve been listening to your feedback regarding toxicity and have partnered with Modulate to test their voice moderation tool called ToxMod.

Sneak Peak: [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ff-qaAsJb4g]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ff-qaAsJb4g[/url] 

[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]NEW FEATURES & GENERAL CHANGES:[/b][/h3]

[b]Toxmod[/b]
[list][*] We’ve partnered with Modulate to test their voice moderation software called ToxMod.
[*] ToxMod works by analyzing voice chat audio in-game. You can think of it as an unbiased additional player in your lobby, looking out for and reporting toxic incidents. If it detects toxic activity, it flags it as such and sends that audio to us in a report. ToxMod allows us to listen back to flagged audio in a game without having a player record it themselves. Other Ocean and Modulate both take player privacy seriously - any audio from survivors will be anonymized and automatically deleted after 30 days.
[*] ToxMod is not an automatic banning system; nothing will change about the way we enforce our Community Guidelines. You will not be banned for swearing or for friendly banter with your friends. We will continue to manually review each case, carefully consider the context, and investigate before taking any action.[/list]

[b]Timeline Refresh[/b]
[list][*] We’ve refreshed and updated the Timeline screen to display the time and location of match events.
[*] This will allow players to view which areas of the map saw the most action, and get a better picture of what happened across the whole map.[/list]

notes.title: Addressing Community Toxicity
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33747333/8b0961b8a6dc45579b1fa4c184e362d960955642.png[/img]

The Steam Winter Sale has brought in a lot of new players which is always exciting! With new players comes new feedback and reviews - some good and some bad. We are aware that we are dealing with issues of increased player toxicity and are working on developing and finding new tools to help combat it. 

We ask that any players who witness or experience toxic behavior report both in-game and through our [url=https://discord.gg/projectwinter]discord[/url] ticket system in the report-player channel. Our goal is to reduce toxicity and create a better player experience that will allow our playerbase to continue to grow. 

[b]A reminder of some of our community guideline rules relating to toxicity:[/b]
1. Be excellent to each other
5. Harassment of any form will not be tolerated
6. Trolling, Griefing, or intending to lose (disconnecting, AFKing, Idling or refusing to play, basically ruining anyone else's game on purpose) will not be tolerated

notes.title: Ace social deduction survival murder sim Project Winter adds new roles and systems
notes.notes:
Project Winter is one of the best social deduction games you can play on your PC. You could uncharitably call it the grumpy rules lawer uncle of Among Us, smothering the raw thrill of lies and accusation beneath a blanket of systems and complexities. I had an absolute blast with it a few years ago, though, and for my money the highs absolutely make that blanket worth snuggling under.

I get to tell you about it again because the Power Balance: Vol 2 Update came out last week, adding a couple more roles and new systems that give traitors more strategies to turn to.

Read more

notes.title: Power Balance: Vol 1 Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33747333/0c6b19c2836be7cc15d47b401474c235b154c1d1.png[/img]

A new update is here and it’s the first of two that will introduce new strategies and ways to play the game. 

The balance of “power” is shifting as we move to introduce more ways to focus on the social deception and roleplay aspects of the game. 

The biggest addition in this update are four new items: Disguise Kit, Snow Shoes, Ice Bomb and Sound Emitter. 

Short Teaser: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hCJC4eNCXn0
Long Teaser: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=37EyHfVWyK0﻿

In addition to this update, we’re proud to announce that Project Winter has hit a milestone of 2.5 M users across all platforms! 

We want to thank everyone who has supported us as we continue to update and provide new content for our community. 

Starting today Project Winter will have a permanent price drop. Spread the news and invite your friends for the optimal backstabbing experience! 

[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]NEW FEATURES & GENERAL CHANGES:[/b][/h3]

[b]NEW ITEMS[/b]

[b]1. Disguise Kit[/b]
[list][*] A single-use item that functions similarly to the “Swap Clothes” mechanic. This item allows players to disguise themselves as another player regardless of their status as living or dead. The disguise lasts for a limited amount of time, and consumes the kit when used. This item can be crafted at the Crafting Table.
[*] This item provides opportunities for Traitors (or cheeky survivors) to shift the blame to other players while commiting traitorous acts. This item doubles as a source of security of being caught sabotaging or killing others, as players will not see the actual clothing of the person committing the crime.[/list]
[b]2. Snow Shoes[/b]
[list][*] A single-use item that removes their snow trail and footstep audio. These effects last for a short amount of time before wearing off. This item can be crafted by Traitors at the Crafting Table.
[*] This item opens up more stealth strategies for traitors. Allowing traitors to sneak into objectives and steal parts without a trail, and making quick getaways if they’re caught.[/list]
[b]3. Ice Bomb[/b]
[list][*] A single-use item similar to the Smoke Bomb that creates a cloud of icey smoke upon use. When activated, the icey smoke will cause players to lose warmth rapidly when standing in Ice Bomb’s radius. It can be used from the hand, as a trap, or thrown. This item can be crafted at the Crafting Table.
[*] The Ice Bomb offers a unique opportunity that many other items do not. It provides Traitors a way to prevent survivors from entering an area, or deterring them from attacking for an extended amount of time, where traditional traps are removed after activation.[/list]
[b]4. Sound Emitter[/b]
[list][*] A single-use item that emits audio clips over a short amount of time before the item self-destructs. This item is placed like a trap, and will play suspicious audio cues that players can hear from quite a distance.
[*] This item aims to provide a way for Traitors to distract or lure survivors away from their current objective and either sidetrack or Ambush.[/list]
[b]BLACKOUT CHANGES[/b]
[list][*] Added Dig site and Animal wave as possible first objectives
[*] Increased the max amount of roles that can be in matches:
[b]1. Defector[/b]
- Min: 0, Max: 2 (Old Min: 0, Max: 1)
[b]2. Scout[/b]
- Min: 0, Max: 3 (Old Min: 0, Max: 2)
[b]3. Tracker[/b]
- Min: 0, Max: 3 [/list]

notes.title: Arming For Truth
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33747333/4240b0acb237ff51516315b5575298eec72b6c44.png[/img]

It’s update time! We’ve given some love to the Truth Serum Lab and the Armory. 

We hope with these changes that players will be able to use these resources more and that they will add more value to their Project Winter experience. 

Controller and console players have also gotten some extra attention this update! We have added in better inventory management for players who use controllers. This includes the ability to swap item locations and radios within the hot bar!

[b]Teaser:[/b] [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WkzN9OMCvEY]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WkzN9OMCvEY[/url]
[b]Full Sneak Peak:[/b] [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6SpDuxSYUmo]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6SpDuxSYUmo[/url]

[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]NEW FEATURES & GENERAL CHANGES:[/b][/h3]

[b]Truth Serum Lab Rework[/b]
[list][*] Truth Serum Lab no longer requires the first objective to be repaired before allowing players to open it via interacting with all three lab consoles
[*] Lazarus Machine now requires 6 animal meat, down from 9
[*] Truth Serum Syringes are now locked behind the completion of the first objective
[*] Second Truth Serum container’s timer is not started until the first serum has been removed from its container
[*] Truth Serum Lab can no longer be hacked open until the first objective has been repaired
[*] A Survivor revived by another Survivor will now always revive with a basic Survivor role with no abilities
[*] Truth Serum Lab crates have a new loot table centered around survival items instead of objective requirements.
[*] Traitors can now sabotage a Truth Serum Syringe at the crafting table
[*] When used by a survivor, the Sabotaged Syringe will show the opposite team of the player tested
[*] When used by a Traitor, the Sabotaged Syringe will show the tested player’s role.[/list]
[b]Armory Rework[/b]
[list][*] Armory is marked on the map for traitors after the completion of the first objective
[*] Players can use the new “Reveal Armory Location” prompt on Armory consoles to mark the Armory on the cabin mapboard. 
[*] This marks the location for ALL players in the game.
[*] Audio and visual global announcements when activated/opened
[*] An alarm will play when the Armory is opened
[*] This alarm is heard from multiple tiles away and will last a short amount of time
[*] A banner is displayed across the screen indicating to players that the Armory has been opened.
[*] Armory crates have received a new loot table that centers around offensive weapons and traps.
[*] The likelihood of energy drinks has been decreased in Armory crates
[*] Tier 2 energy drink now costs 3 traitor credits[/list]
[b]Controller Inventory Management[/b]
[list][*] Controller functionality is added allowing the swapping of item locations in the hotbar
[*]Pressing the UP directional pad button will enable this feature in game.
[*] Added functionality for controller to swap between radios, and remove a radio from the equipment slot to the player inventory[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]BALANCE CHANGES:[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Reduced the likelihood of gun parts to spawn outside of the Armory. This includes Bunkers, Towerbunkers, and Airdrops.
[*] Added “Default” and “Current” Regions to settings for players who frequently change regions to ensure they always have a default to connect to when launch the game
[*] Moved “Host Game” Button and renamed “Host your own game” to more easily host games
[*] Added a prompt to Host your own game or switch regions when no lobbies are available
[*] Enabled push to talk voip to work while the ESC menus are open
[*] Lobby Voice keybind now available in the control settings menu
[*] Updating the controller inventory management to allow better control of the RADIO SLOT for the players who use controllers
[*] Minor menu and loading improvements
[*] Minor PS4 performance improvements
[*] Lowered volume for Thundersnow by 5%
[*] Added capabilities of multiple blessing from different padre’s in custom Blackout[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]KNOWN ISSUES:[/b][/h3]
[list][*] [Switch] User is unable to navigate to the Close button in the Players menu while using a controller. Note: You can close using touch screen functions
[*] Custom Blackout matches with the Cipher or Dig Site objectives selected will start with no first objective on the map
[*] Character model will have a square hair when wearing a hat or a bald head without a hat when the user equips a Ghillie Jacket and a Wild Cape
[*] "Selected Preset" does not update when the host selects a new preset in a custom lobby
[*] Drop cursor icon gets stuck on the screen if the player uses a controller and the mouse at the same time
[*] Users will remain muted when unblocking them in the Friends menu
[*] Player can get trapped behind the cabin in basic practice mode by walking on rocks
[*] Intermittently the Settings menu 'Default Region' will display Best [Unknown] after switching regions via the lobby menus[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]BUG FIXES:[/b][/h3]
[list][*] [PS4] Fixed issue where dropping rocks on certain maps heavily affect FPS
[*] Fixed instances where volume text will overlap the player-specific volume slider in the lobby when selecting several supported languages
[*] [PC/Win10] Fixed instances where switching from mouse and keyboard to controller prompts actions to prompt players to “click” instead of “select”
[*] Fixed instances where increasing objective difficulty prevented players from completing Dig Site objective in custom mode
[*] Fixed instances with Dig Site objective where unstackable items can now be stacked into repair inventories via dragging
[*] Fixed instances with Dig Site objective Dragging a stack of normally unstackable items from a repair inventory will now drop only one from the stack and no longer lose the rest of the stack
[*] Dying to Thundersnow lightning no longer shows the host player as an attacker in the Timeline event
[*] Armory location now displays on map for Traitors when advanced roles are turned off during custom games
[*] More than one Padre is now able to bless the same player
[*] [Switch][Xbox] Fixed Switch + Xbox crash that could occur under certain game settings while progressing the Animal Wave objective
[*] Fixed instances where you can not trap Lab with poison/landmine/tripwire
[*] Lab can now be opened via activating one console during a practice game or custom game with one player in the match
[*] Fixed issue with poisoned items and sabotaged syringes being stackable with their non effect equivalents
[*] Added supports to plushie backpack so the traitor doesn't fall out when running
[*] Win10 can now properly exit game from the main menu using in game prompt
[*] Added Scout icon to show instead of generic Survivor icon when revealing a neutral role with truth serum
[*] Fixed input and controller pairing issues 
[*] Added a few missing hiragana characters to japanese language asset.
[*] Fixed instances where client's Save button is non-functional in the Preset Settings menu within the lobby
[*] Disabled save button interaction when player’s have too many presets already
[*] Fixed instances where hitting enter three times while in game doesn't allow the player to type and no text cursor appears in the chat box
[*] Removed save button from custom settings preview when it doesn't belong.
[*] Fixed lobby name censoring to work as intended
[*] Blot out the room name in the header part of the lobby UI (or just naughty words within the room name) if it contains naughty words.
[*] Present the name of the room creator in the header part of the lobby UI on PS4.  The name (or naughty words within) will be blotted out if it contains naughty words, which should not happen for PSN names but could for a name from a different network.
[*] Fixed instances when consoles are placed in a suspended state, when the consoles are resumed the Game’s timer is not accurate
[*] Fixed incorrect elapsed times shown on "Choose a Lobby" screen after resuming from rest mode.
[*] Replaced air freshener in cabin with Winter Fresh Scent
[*] Fixed some icon’s showing incorrectly in menu and lobby
[*] Fixed the Volume text will overlap the player-specific volume slider in the lobby when selecting several supported languages
[*] Fixed close button spacing issues with some languages
[*] Fixed instances where preferred Game Mode selection text overlaps the drop menu when the Russian or Greek languages are selected
[*] Fixed instances where players could hear electrical noise while entering loading screen for match
[*] Fixed instances where Thundersnow SFX can persist into a new game after escaping during event
[*] Fixed Custom Game Settings in Blackout appear as default Custom Game Settings
[*] Fixed visualization of community events overlapping in lobby
[*] Fixed neutral roles showing as “innocent” instead of Scout when being truth serumed by a traitor
[*] Fixed instances where names of Community Events extend beyond the Progress bar when Blackout is not installed
[*] Fixed instances where players will crash during the Animal Wave objective if it spawns on specific the North Tiles
[*] Fixed instances when a player attempts to report another player with a censored name and their name becomes uncensored
[*] Fixed instances where players cannot save Custom presets if the character limit in the Name or Description fields are reached
[*] Fixed the "Custom Settings" menu when the character limit for the description appears as 100 while the character limit appears as 50 when saving from the "Preset Settings" menu
[*] Fixed map board to feel more supported and less likely to fall over during blizzard
[*] Fixed instances where no Save screen pop-up appears when closing the Preset Settings menu after making changes to the settings
[*] [PS4] Fixed instances where Interaction prompts can intermittently disappear for the duration of the match[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]NEW COSMETICS TO EARN[/b][/h3]
New store items available at approximately 4:00PM EST

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33747333/08b53cf23b72e9838b00cd897a771aa2863b48c1.png[/img]
[h3][b]Keep your feedback coming![/b][/h3]
As always, we are listening and we encourage everyone to leave feedback in our community [url=discord.gg/projectwinter]Discord[/url] in the #suggestions channel.

Stay tuned for more updates in the future, and thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Thunder Pressure
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33747333/c90702e2ab45671cbb6594935dddeab565aa0d30.png[/img]
Hey Zeus, take the wheel! 

This Project Winter update includes a shockingly new global event - Thundersnow, a blizzard filled with thunder and lightning! 

We’ve also reworked some of our social aspects with some new additions to the friends list and toxic management! 

Do you think you can handle the thunder pressure?

[b]Teaser:[/b] [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DJXaakJa9VU]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DJXaakJa9VU[/url]
[b]Full Sneak Peak:[/b] [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e_jb8wpvuN0]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e_jb8wpvuN0[/url]

[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]NEW FEATURES & GENERAL CHANGES:[/b][/h3]

[b]New Weather Event - Thundersnow:[/b]
Thundersnow, like its real life equivalent, is a blizzard that produces lightning and thunder. This global event will cause certain electrical components to be inoperable until the Thundersnow passes.

[b]Friends List Update[/b]
Now players can sort by online players, see who is already in a match, search for specific players in their friends list, and add friends or block users from other screens.

[b]Toxicity Management Update[/b]

notes.title: Timing is Everything
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33747333/7b8b5e25a07d88ba9cd3a16734d397c702bc9526.png[/img]

Greeting Survivors! 

Timing is Everything in today’s update as we introduce Timed Challenges and Events - a new way of rewarding players for playing the game.

This update we are introducing 3 themed events:
[list][*] Search and Rescue
[*] Lab Testing Day
[*] Hunting Season[/list]More events will be coming soon!

[previewyoutube=Viyu6HN4OPw;full][/previewyoutube]

Each of these events have a unique set of challenges for players to complete while playing Project Winter. When an event starts, players will receive 3 challenges at random from the event's pool of challenges. For each challenge a player completes, they are given a reward. These rewards range from in game currency, to old cosmetics, and even unique event themed cosmetics. Additionally, every event has a "Community Challenge". This challenge is the same for all players, and as a community you will have to work towards completing the challenges for an additional reward.

The duration of each event will be 7 days. This number will likely change as we get a feel for how fast the community completes the challenges. Once an event ends, a new event will start immediately after. This means every month, you will have 4 uniquely themed challenges to complete, with special rewards for completion.

Progress for events does not carry over between cycles. If you get 50% of the way through a challenge during a Search and Rescue event but do not complete it in time, the next time the Search and Rescue event appears, you will have to start over. This is because every time an event repeats, it is given new challenges, and it does not make sense to carry progress from two separate challenges.

Each themed event is going to repeat, and each time you will receive a new set of challenges. To unlock the full unique cosmetic set for each event it WILL take multiple event cycles to receive each reward. There are enough challenges and variations in rewards that players should receive new challenges every time an event repeats.

We've heard your feedback about previous challenges as well. For the Timed Event Challenges, we've tried our best to ensure that all of these challenges are progressible in normal gameplay. This way players should not see much disruption in gameplay like we have seen during holiday events.

Full Sneak Peak of Update: [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Q5BGjLdBKWw]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Q5BGjLdBKWw[/url]

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33747333/8851cc2bd7967a1b19f1d0d1bebcfae5f628e8a4.png[/img]

Stabby Holidays Survivors!

'Tis the season for Treason! You will notice the cabin has some holiday cheer sprinkled over it - brought to you by the Project Winter elves! 

This update is filled with a bunch of presents that we’re excited to share with you! We’ve added an in-game friends list, traitor ability items, and additions to custom modes including custom Blackout! Plus some other extra goodies and bug fixes! 

Our Holiday event will also be extra special this year - stay tuned for more info when it starts on December 20th!

[i]PS. We know you’ve heard of Christmas in July… but have you heard of Summer in December? Our new store items will have you feelin’ sun-sational in the Project Winter Wonderland this holiday season! Available at approximately 3:00PM EST[/i]

[h3][b]NEW FEATURES & GENERAL CHANGES:[/b][/h3]

[*] Players you have blocked cannot join lobbies you host.
[*] If someone you’ve blocked joins a lobby that you’re in (and aren’t hosting), they are automatically muted. [/list]

[list][*] Two of these items are available in every traitor airdrop.
[*] Traitors can also craft these items using traitor credits at the cabin crafting table.
[*] In addition to the original Radio Jammer, Second Objective Locator, Remote Sabotager, and Global Exile Remote items, two new craftable traitor items have been added:
[*] Solar Pulse, which causes a Solar Flare event.
[*] Hysterical Gas, which causes a Mass Hysteria event.
[*] The Remote Sabotager always sabotages the first objective.[/list]
[b]New options have been added to custom games.[/b]
[list][*] Past roles Soldier, Medic, Scientist, Innocent, Traitor Medic, Traitor Scientist, Traitor Hacker, and Saboteur have been added as role options.

[*] An option has been added to disable all visible player names at the start of a match.
[*] An option has been added to allow disabling ghost abilities, including the ability for ghosts to pick up and put down items.
[*] An option has been added that causes possible second objective locations to show have beacons to all players similar to the first objective beacon.
[*] Players can more easily see the settings of a custom game lobby without joining it.
[*] An abbreviated list of settings is visible on the left side of the lobby list.
[*] Players can press the “Custom Settings” button on a lobby’s list entry to see all the settings [/list]
[b]Players can now create custom Blackout games.[/b]
[list][*] All options available in standard custom games are available in custom Blackout games, except for map and first objective selection.
[*] Two presets are available by default for custom Blackout matches, the Monster Mishmash and Whispers in the Wind. [/list]
[list][*] [Blackout] Traitors can now sabotage hatches in Blackout matches.
[*] Sabotaging a hatch sends the next player who uses it to a random location on the map.
[*] [Blackout] If a whisperer attempts to use their ability while no player is in their radius, the ability does not get used and does not expend the charge.
[*] New player tips for the dig site objective have been improved.

notes.title: Change Ahead
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33747333/9394fcfc7b0825a080cac7ca9d40a3b27b582113.png[/img]

Greetings Survivors! 

First of all, we wanted to thank everyone for their feedback on the latest updates, and for your patience while we work towards porting Project Winter to other platforms. This latest update will only be available on Steam at this current moment, meaning crossplay between Steam and Microsoft will [b]not[/b] be compatible. This is to prepare for our release on other platforms - which will be announced [b]soon™[/b]. We understand that this could bring inconvenience for some players during this time, but we hope that this will better help us get all the platforms on the same content update in the long run due to certification and approval processes.

The last couple of updates have introduced some changes to our beloved roles, and implemented some changes and systems to help improve overall player experience! This update works towards better balancing through additional role changes and improving the social ranking system. 

We’re also introducing changes to ghost gameplay! Ghosts now have their own bonus challenges, an inventory slot and more balanced abilities overall! We hope these improvements will allow for more fun ghost gameplay - both for ghosts and the players still alive in the game!

[h3][b]NEW FEATURES & GENERAL CHANGES:[/b][/h3]

[b]ROLES:[/b]
We are working towards an optimal balance of the roles that allows our playerbase to have fun while also maintaining the overall goals of Project Winter. Our main focus is to promote communication and teamwork while providing tools and roles that allow for social deception plays. We are introducing some changes that we hope will be stepping stones towards that balance:
[list][*] Soldier, Scientist, Traitor Scientist, Medic, and Traitor Medic roles have been [b]removed[/b].

[*] Any 3 players can open the armory together.
[*] The armory can only be opened after the first objective has been completed.
[*] The armory no longer appears on the minimap for any role.

[*] Any player can use the lazarus machine.
[*] The lazarus machine requires [b]meat and fur[/b] in addition to a human heart.
[*] Any player resurrected by the lazarus machine will be on the same team as the player who resurrected them.
[*] If a traitor resurrects someone, they’re revived as a traitor. If a survivor resurrects someone, they’re revived as a survivor. If an ID thief that has not stolen a role resurrects someone, there is a 50/50 chance of them being a traitor or survivor.

[*] [b]A new role is added: the Tracker[/b].
[*] The Tracker can use their ability to “tag” players, bunker consoles, and the second objective (before the repair beacon has been activated).
[*] Tagging one of the above lets the tracker see where they are in relation to that player/console/objective at all times, similar to a flare or beacon.
[*] Trackers can only tag one thing at a time, and can switch their tag from their initial target when their ability is charged.

[*] The defector’s ability charges slowly when they are around many people, and charges quickly when they are around less people.
[*] ID Thieves can see the location of the first death/dead body in a match on the minimap.
[*] ID Thief’s role description has been reworded to better communicate the purpose of their role.
[*] Detectives no longer hear dead body proximity music next to a body once they have investigated that body.
[*] Dead body proximity for both the detective and ID thief is controlled by the Music slider in the settings instead of the Ambient/SFX slider.[/list]
[b]GHOST GAMEPLAY:[/b]
[list][*] Ghosts can claim ghost-specific bonus challenges from the map outside the cabin.
[*] Ghosts can only claim one ghost bonus challenge at a time, but can complete an unlimited number of ghost bonus challenges during a match.
[*] Ghosts get one inventory slot that they can use to pick up and drop loose items.
[*] Ghosts pick up items much slower than living players.
[*] Items do not stack for ghosts. Ghosts can only pick up one item at a time.
[*] If ghosts pick up poison, they can use it to poison interactable objects.
[*] The visual effects for ghost abilities (ghost freeze, ghost heal, etc) are only visible to the players affected by those ghost abilities.
[*] Ghost feast and ghost fire are changed to be AOE abilities similar to ghost freeze and ghost heal.
[*] The amount of hunger granted by ghost feast is increased to 40.
[*] The amount of warmth granted by ghost fire is increased to 40.
[*] The amount of health granted by ghost heal is increased to 40.
[*] The amount of warmth taken away by ghost freeze is increased to 30.[/list]
[b]SOCIAL RANK:[/b]
We’ve decided to implement some changes to the social ranking system in an attempt to improve the system so that it is more accurate and to better reduce toxicity. 
[list][*] All players will revert back to the bronze social rank once a month.
[*] The amount of reputation points a player needs to reach higher social ranks has been adjusted to reflect this change.
[*] Players receive reputation points for staying in Basic and Normal matches to completion, whether that player is alive or dead.
[*] Thumbs up have been replaced by commendations.
[*] Commendations can be given at the end of a match and grant the receiver reputation points, the same as a thumbs up.
[*] Commendation categories are Friendly, Good Teacher, Good Leader, and Master of Deceit.
[*] Players cannot give commendations to the same player more than twice per day.
[*] Commendation counts do not reset during monthly social rank resets.
[*] Players must have at least 25 total commendations to advance to the silver rank, and at least 50 total commendations to advance to the gold rank.
[*] Players can only give one type of commendation per match.
[*] Commendations cannot be given during Custom matches.
[*] Commendations are displayed on your player profile.
[*] Players can view the commendation counts and leave ratios of other players in their lobby by selecting their lobby entry.[/list]
[h3][b]BALANCE CHANGES:[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Default role distribution in Normal and Blackout matches is adjusted to reflect the role changes.
[*] The maximum number of Defectors in a match is increased to 2.
[*] The maximum number of Scouts in a match is increased to 3.
[*] Buttons for teleporting to other players while playing as a ghost have been remapped to account for being able to pick up/put down items.
[*] Megablizzard incoming message has been reworded
[*] Navigation to lobby sorting options on controller has been changed so they can be reached with Y
[*] Melee weapons excluding the torch will now show the minimum damage to the closest multiple of 5 that's lower.[/list]
[h3][b]BUG FIXES:[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Fixed report form navigation on controller for the other toggle showing an input field
[*] Fixed issue with caching rewards causing rewards to never update.
[*] Fixed player report form having no navigation
[*] Fixed dead body proximity music not playing for resurrected roles that should have dead body proximity music
[*] Fixed an issue where custom settings for min/max traitor values were not handled correctly.
[*] Fixed issue where player ranks weren't showing up correctly in lobby as well as in game over screen and in commendation block
[*] Fixed clipping issues with Wild cape white large male cape
[*] Fixed clipping issues with Wild Cape Brown/Black/White
[*] Dig photos popup now disables the tooltips from showing up
[*] [Controller] Crafting info tooltips changed to toggle when you press left/right and disable once you change.
[*] Fix for the social reward popup blocking UICancel for most other stuff in the scene.
[*] Improved mkb aiming especially in cases when aiming at targets on the left/right side of the screen
[*] * when aiming over a valid target, aim shifts very slightly towards the center for more accurate visuals
[*] * hitscan weapons shoot towards the center of the target as long as it is a valid target
[*] Fixed retry connection popup not working as intended and attempting to reconnect while the internet remains disconnected
[*] Added messaging to preferred game mode popup to indicate that the player's region changes to "best" when quick matching
[*] Fixed issue where players would appear to have more crates in their inventory resulting in opening errors
[*] Fixed issue where animals (bears) would seem like they were disappearing
[*] Fixed player list entries to fade instead of being removed. Now players who left can still be reported
[*] Fixed bug where camera would focus on body, not ghost of dead player in gondola area. 
[*] Fixed bug where multiple updates were causing role ability to flash and the sound to go off constantly
[*] Fixed early leave timer when a player leaves a game early as red rank.
[*] Fixed traitors being able to break for free when survivor walked away from their console, 
[*] Fixed bear traps trapping the placer if they've been placed before
[*] Fixed bug where Nameplate of player was disappearing permanently by using landmine to launch into outhouse.  
[*] Fixed issue where changing custom game objectives would change practice mode menu objectives selection
[*] [Controller] Fixed navigation issue on Practice Mode menu
[*] Fixed issue where traitor chat radio tab was not displaying properly for ID Thief
[*] Deleted poop models[/list]
[h3][b]NEW COSMETICS TO EARN[/b][/h3]

New store items available at [b]4:30PM EST[/b]﻿
[i]* We unfortunately had to disable the Wild Cape (Black/Brown/White) due to a bug it caused. This will be addressed in the hot fix for this update.[/i]

We hope you’ve been enjoying the latest role revival update!

Our community is our number one priority always. So it’s time for a little community service!

In this update we’ve made some changes to our reporting, ranking and lobby systems to help improve player experience - both new and veterans. This is the first phase to enhance player experience and we look forward to hearing your feedback!  

We also added in a completely new mode - Practice Mode! A playground to learn the in and outs of Project Winter! This single player mode will allow you to play through a match and try out different roles and items at your own pace! 

[h3][b]NEW FEATURES & GENERAL CHANGES:[/b][/h3]
[list][*] A report button has been added to the dropdown menu when selecting a player’s entry in the lobby
[*] In-game reports on console and controller have check boxes for report reasons
[*] Lobby hosts can bar red ranks from joining their lobbies
[*] Bronze, silver, and gold players get a free cosmetics crate every week
[*] A player’s early leave ratio is displayed on their player profile
[*] Health, warmth, and hunger bars now more clearly show buffs and debuffs to your stats [/list]
The amount of times a player has killed other players is listed on their player profile.
[list][*] This value is only tracked after this update --your kills before the update aren’t there, sorry! [/list]
Players can vote to kick other players out of a match after a match has begun
[list][*] If a player is kicked out of a match, all players remaining do not gain any SP or artifacts from the rest of that match
[*] Players with red ranks cannot vote kick [/list]
Practice mode has been added
[list][*] Practice mode is a single-player way to play through a match of Project Winter and try out different items and roles [/list]
[h3][b]BALANCE CHANGES:[/b][/h3]
[list][*] In-game reports will not affect your social ranking unless the reporter leaves a comment
[*] Loading screen tips have been added RE: reporting players
[*] Players have to wait 20 seconds before rejoining a lobby they have just left
[*] Currency gain is increased for silver and gold ranks, and decreased for red and bright red ranks.
[*] Red ranks must wait until their most recent match has ended before joining a new one
[*] Frequently quitting games while you are still alive lowers your social rank
[*] “Results” tab in the match over screen has been renamed to “upvotes”, and players’ social ranks are visible there
[*] Text has been added to the your player profile explaining the rewards/penalties for your current rank
[*] Using ranged weapons or throwing items while using a controller has been improved[/list]
Tips have been added for new players regarding the weather, objectives, and ranged weapons
[list][*] All new player tips show up 3 times total instead of just once[/list]
[h3][b]BUG FIXES:[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Fixed a bug where there could be  loss of navigation as a result of entering a password to the lobby password popup.
[*] Cosmetics - Fixed a bug where Striped Cape could appear different between the character model and the inventory.
[*] Cosmetics - Fixed appearance of torso fur standard male and standard female
[*] Cosmetics - Bandanas fixed to avoid HairBraidSide clipping. Hair SideBraid, and HairSideBraid clip.
[*] Fixed issue where sickle shears items would generate errors on the main menu when equipped
[*] Cleaned up the invitation system for Steam, Xbox and Win Crossplay. Should be more stable now.
[*] Fixed instance where player could buy a progression item multiple times.
[*] Fixed multiple localization errors in all languages.
[*] Fixed instances where censored names were being uncensored in the end of game event timeline.
[*] Fixed instances where the censored names were being uncensored on the truth serum reveal notification.
[*] Fixed instances where the helicopter rescue event could give null references.
[*] "Fixed" the "Alien Cube Of Doom" appearing, becoming sentient and floating above the level. 
[*] Fixed an instance where cloned players could not see the red "damage" vignette when taking damage.
[*] Fixed a bug where the end game blizzard would not trigger if the host disconnected just before the blizzard started.
[*] Fixed an instance where Sabotaging the TNT consoles did not cost credits.
[*] Fixed an instance where the tutorial progress could be blocked if the user spent traitor credits on the "break" or "wolf trap" actions on bunkers
[*] Fixed a bug where players buttons could become unresponsive and could not be selected when opening the menu after reaching the "Match Over" screen on a crossplay lobby.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Yeti had access to a "break" option when attempting to use a bunker.
[*] Fixed a bug where a player could negate the effect of a Solar Flare Event if they used a hatch at the correct time.
[*] Fixed a bug where the minimap would still be present if the player used a hatch at the correct time during a Solar Flare Event.
[*] Fixed a bug where the player could become invincible if they used a traitor hatch as they reached zero health.
[*] Fixed a few instances where the "survive without..." bonus objective could be completed if the player died to a sabotaged Fulton Escape.
[*] Xbox: Fixed an instance where the gamer pic would show an error instead of a placeholder generic image.
[*] Xbox: Fixed instances where the social rating icons appear pixelated / low resolution.
[*] Xbox: Improved aiming systems on controllers.
[*] Improved navigational paths for wildlife around bridges.
[*] Fixed instances where a wave objective could spawn on an island, causing the animals to get stuck in certain tile areas.
[*] Fixed instances where the player's end of game score was not calculated properly
[*] Clarified text for the "votekick" explanation pop up.
[*] Fixed a few instances where the graphics could become corrupted if a player used the crafting table while weather events were active.[/list]
[h3][b]NEW COSMETICS TO EARN[/b][/h3]

[i]New store items available at approximately 4:15PM EST﻿[/i]

As always, we are listening and we encourage everyone to leave feedback in our community [url=discord.gg/projectwinter]Discord[/url] in the #suggestions channel.

Stay tuned for more updates in the future, and thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Role Revival
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33747333/2a113fc6dcfadf25660e544e2a5fa8e31c9aae9f.png[/img]

Greetings Survivors! 

We hope you all have been enjoying your rides on the gondola and appreciate your feedback and patience as we worked on this newest update!

So hear us out… 

What if a survivor could use the hatch? 
What if a hacker could open the truth serum lab alone? 
What if a detective could investigate traitor crates? 
What if traitors could sabotage the fire in the cabin? 
What if poison effects were delayed? 
What if traitor crates had purchasable items?

...what if? What if… we updated some of our beloved roles?

Are you ready to role with the punches? Can you be a wolf in sheep’s clothing in this latest Project Winter update? 

[h3][b]NEW FEATURES & GENERAL CHANGES:[/b][/h3]

The Innocent role has been removed and replaced with the “Scout” role:
[list][*] Scouts can use traitor hatches
[*] When using a radio Scouts will see where other players transmitting with the same color radio are on the map[/list]
Changes to Traitors:
[list][*] When using a radio standard traitors can now see where other players transmitting with the same color radio are on the map. This includes both red traitor radios and other colour radios if they decide to use them
[*] Traitor hacker has been removed, and all traitors can now open bunkers with traitor credits
[*] All Traitors can open the truth serum lab and armory with traitor credits
[*] Traitors can “repair and sabotage with delay” an objective, which repairs an objective and automatically sabotages it after a period of time
[*] Traitors can sabotage the fireplace so the cabin will not restore heat until it is repaired with wood
[*] Traitors can sabotage a bunker to guarantee that a wolf will come out of it when the bunker is opened
[*] Traitors must now purchase items from traitor crates using traitor credits. Items in traitor drops remain the same and are not required to be purchased[/list]
Changes to Hackers:
[list][*] Hackers no longer need electronic scrap to open bunkers
[*] Hackers can open the truth serum lab and armory with electronic scrap[/list]
Changes to Detective:
[list][*] Detectives can investigate traitor crates to potentially deduce who opened them
[*] Detectives can use trap disarm kits to see who placed the traps they disarm

[*] Detectives and ID Thieves now hear a jazzy theme song when they approach a dead body
[*] Added the ability to choose map in Custom Mode[/list]
[h3][b]BALANCE CHANGES:[/b][/h3]

Changes to Poison:
[list][*] Poison’s effects are now delayed after consuming or interacting with a poisoned object
[*] A player who poisons another player sees a timer over the poisoned player’s head counting down to when their poison takes effect
[*] Poisoned items now stack with non-poisoned items of the same type
[*] Poison and poisoned crossbow bolts cause the player to lose heat in addition to their other effects
[*] Player gets a message on the global events banner when poison takes effect
[*] Poisonings and the identity of the poisoner are shown on the timeline at the end of a match[/list]
Changes to Traitors:
[list][*] Traitors can see what bunkers have been broken and/or sabotaged with a wolf
[*] The bonus objective “repair objective” has been added
[*] Traitors gain proximity credits (credits from being around other players) faster
[*] Traitors gain more credits from opening traitor crates than they did before[/list]
[list][*] Defector starts the game with their ability 50% charged
[*] Soldiers take 20% less damage from wild animals
[*] All unlock stations must now be activated to open a wolf bunker. 
[*] The truth serum lab and armory proximity text has subtitles that explain those locations in more detail
[*] The player’s current role is highlighted on the roles list
[*] Players can view the roles list from the pause menu
[*] Players using a controller can view HUD tooltips by pressing down on the D-pad.
[*] Players get a system message in the text chat at the beginning of the game telling them where they can get more information on their role
[*] Changed “Radio Station” and “Hydro Station” objective text to “Power Station” to match the name on the building and avoid confusion
[*] Removed sabotage option from armory consoles and lab consoles
[*] Increased the rematch timer to 60 seconds[/list]
[h3][b]BUG FIXES:[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Keyboard settings pop ups no longer have a button automatically selected.
[*] Key binding is now moved a bit to the bottom and will no longer appear behind the message.
[*] Stopping the mouse from triggering any mouse events when it's invisible
[*] [Xbox] fixed issue where a controller disconnect event would occur if any controllers paired user changed rather than the just the active controller
[*] Fixed issues with overlapping font
[*] Fixed the keyboard controls saving changes on close, and made it reset any unsaved changes on close.
[*] Pressing settings revert behavior changed:
[*] Pressing revert when the keyboard keys aren't shown will never bring up the key revert popups anymore.
[*] The restore defaults popup will now be navigable.
[*] The revert button now updates whether it's interactable or not based on tab open
[*] Fixed navigation being lost due to the revert button turning not interactable.
[*] Dismissed announcement will now properly select the button of the next announcement
[*] Added more space to the layout for tool tips of abilities
[*] [Xbox] Added code to disable Controller/Keyboard toggles on the Controls screen
[*] Fixed issue where camera tracks gondola instead of player when player hops off at last second
[*] Fixed] removed/moved floating rocks on many levels
[*] Added backing behind the loading
[*] Fixed Swaying trees on top of rocks on gondola map
[*] Fixed a few instances of players getting stuck in water
[*] Fixed rock collision near Kilauea crater.
[*] Fixed an instance where the player could walk through a part of the mountain on the gondola map by turning on a collider
[*] Fixed an instance where the battery could spawn in the mountains behind the cabin on the gondola map by moving spawn node to bottom of the mountain
[*] Made several collision fixes to stop out of bounds instances on the gondola map
[*] Turned off static batching groups of trees
[*] Added timeline images for new timeline events that were missing them
[*] Made a stopgap fix for doubling/tripling/sounds
[*] Steam/waterfall loops restricted to single global playback
[*] Fixed / added code so players can not ragdoll over top of interactables such as crates and berry bushes which will help to prevent them from ending up in places where they can get stuck.
[*] Added a fix for the ragdolls being able to get stuck in the outhouse when ragdolling into it using a landmine.
[*] Updated the collision on the argo so it would block ragdolls from going under the ramp.
[*] Fixed a bug where when the player is right next to a collider (think of the wall of a building) and the throw animation moves the arm through the collider, the release point is on the opposite side of the collider than the player is and nothing prevents it from releasing inside of the collider. 
[*] Fixed issue with the animal corpses not spawning. 
[*] Fixed an issue with the animals getting stuck and rotating weird on uneven ground.
[*] Added code so we cannot drop items through colliders.
[*] Fixed a couple null references when animals die.
[*] Added code to stop dragging players at the start and stop of the mass hysteria event.
[*] Fixed an issue where the root transform was not being updated on other clients. This was making it so the bodies could become very far apart between clients.
[*] Fixed instances where some items have really large colliders which when dropped by a wall are larger than the wall itself. 
[*] Fixed issue with players being able to get items stuck on the roof on the outhouse
[*] Fixed issue where the player becomes non-responsive and invincible if they fall right before being ragdolled.
[*] Added code to make the line of sight work a little different for throwable objects vs normal interactables. 
[*] Fix added for animals being able to be pushed around when stuck in a bear trap.  
[*] [Xbox/Win10] Added a dialog box for when the player attempts to invite without having any friends in his list.
[*] Added code to make it so we can pick up a radio and have it go to the radio slot
[*] Fixed many collision issues across multiple maps
[*] Updated the ragdoll sync code so that if the client's ragdoll is within a short distance of the owner's ragdoll, then the client just retains it's local transforms rather than applying the owners transforms. But if it's larger than the acceptable distance, then it snaps to the owner's transforms.
[*] [Xbox] Fixed issue where Xbox One players could not remove the lobby password
[*] Fixed Buy DLC button remaining active on Rewards tab when switching between purchase DLC crate option and open inventory crate option
[*] Fixed Code Terminal UI not appearing in some bunkers
[*] Store items with no purchase limit on Steam are now limited for non-Steam platforms
[*] DLC banner changes on the Rewards tab for controllers
[*]    * disabled the Purchase DLC button for controllers
[*]    * updated the controller legend from Buy to Purchase DLC for controller if hovering DLC crate without owning DLC
[*] [Xbox/Win10] Added option when joining via invites to require password input.
[*] Fixed issue where Crossplay Setting was defaulting to off when clicking the revert button in settings
[*] Added password button for new host when old host leaves lobby
[*] Fixed terminals going idle after sabotaging
[*] Added the missing button D-pad down into the controller images.
[*] Fixed issue with dead body proximity not stopping when a player exits game through game over
[*] Fixed Scrolling and navigation issues in the Settings
[*] Fixed issue where the game stops working if a name has {curly brackets}.
[*] Fixed mouse input to not allow the emote radial to show up and mess things up.
[*] Fixed an issue where walking away would not let the bunker missions complete.
[*] Fixed the labels disappearing when the host goes into a rematch while other players stay in the game over screen.
[*] Reverted ghost and ingame controls being checked against each other when binding.
[*] Added a refresh to the cursor in case it somehow disappears while in mkb mode.
[*] The radial wheel layout should no longer mess up placement upon exiting and opening it repeatedly.
[*] Fix for tooltips only showing up the first time they're triggered up on crafting tables.
[*] Redid an older issue where the tips appeared when the game over screen showed up.
[*] When the game over statistics screen comes up, the tips now get disabled.
[*] Fixed the spanish text for PASSWORD_UNLOCK. Has been updated to proper translation.
[*] Fixed issue where main menu UI breaks if player tries to rematch, but another player has recently opened a lobby with the same name as the rematch lobby
[*] Fixed an instance where sabotage doesn't work correctly if host disconnected around the same time as objective sabotaged
[*] Fixed an issue where easter crates were not removed from inventory when opened
[*] Fixed gondola timeline entry not appearing on all clients
[*] Adjusted text box widths on the Controls section of the game guide to fix issues with text getting cut off on some languages
[*] Fixed issue with moose gathering at the cabin when host disconnects
[*] Made progression of tasks based on escaping with items exclude sabotaged escapes
[*] Fixed instances for projectiles hitting buildings instead of the player in front of the buildings.
[*] Converted Traitors will no longer keep showing survivor air drops
[*] Fixed crashes during quitting process where photon tries to open modal for a disconnection by client.
[*] [Xbox] Fixed settings revert button not being interactable when opening the menu specifically on Xbox[/list]
[h3][b]NEW COSMETICS TO EARN[/b][/h3]
[i]New store items available at approximately 7:00PM EST﻿[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33747333/23bb407793d1c8cc4797535c19769264ac041748.png[/img]

[h3][b]Keep your feedback coming![/b][/h3]
As always, we are listening and we encourage everyone to leave feedback in our community [url=discord.gg/projectwinter]Discord[/url] in the #suggestions channel.

Stay tuned for more updates in the future, and thank you for your continued support!
