notes.title: Elevate Your Betrayal
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33747333/7063683aeb4410346790cb6eee63dc50776c5d60.png[/img]

Greeting Survivors!

The perfect game to back-stab your friends just added a new level of deception. Are you ready?

 A new map has been added in the rotation that may bring some uphill battles and high level gameplays to your Project Winter experience. Be extra careful of who you trust as this map gives a whole new meaning to having a “ride or die” friend!

[previewyoutube=IH40nHt1nak;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]NEW FEATURES & GENERAL CHANGES:[/b][/h3]

[b]Introducing a new map:[/b] [list][*] The cabin is located on the northernmost tile rather than in the center, overlooking the rest of the map from an elevated position
[*] Two options for accessing the rest of the map from the cabin: a [b]gondola[/b] that provides rapid transport to the southernmost tile, or a narrow ramp that descends the cliffside to the immediate area below the cabin
[*] New gameplay dynamics, with the first objective now being located outside the southern gondola station rather than around the cabin and the ability for traitors to delay the gondola via sabotage

[*] Two new main tile variations for the existing normal mode maps which alter the positions of trees, rocks, etc. surrounding the cabin
[*] Text chat can now be used in pregame lobbies, which also logs messages when players join, leave or get kicked
[*] Players can now only upvote the same player once per day at the end of a match
[*] Snow trails will now disappear much faster when a blizzard event is active
[*] Updated naming of bonus objectives to "bonus challenges" and adjusted their scale on the UI to better emphasize the importance of the primary escape objectives
[*] When initiating the escape vehicle countdown, if a survivor is the last remaining player alive, the vehicle will now leave immediately instead of waiting for the countdown
[*] Added sound effect that plays when sending or receiving messages via text chat to better draw attention to it
[*] Various changes to improve UI when using a controller
[*] Updated crossplay icon visuals to help them read better
[*] [Steam] Added new option in general settings to toggle crossplay icon visibility outside of main menu lobby (will now be hidden in-game by default)[/list]

[h3][b]BALANCE CHANGES:[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Traitor radio jamming ability no longer jams red radio channel
[*] Identity Thieves now gain access to the red radio channel when stealing a traitor role
[*] All deployed traps (bear traps, landmines, tripwires) now have a 3 second grace period before the deployer can activate them (previously only on the bear trap)
[*] Tripwires will now slow the player who triggered them by 50% for 10 seconds
[*] Tripwires can now be used to trap crates
[*] Tripwires and alarm traps will now trigger their alarm when activated via the Trap Disarm Kit
[*] Reduced duration of bear traps on polar bears
[*] Explosive crossbow bolts no longer cause players to ragdoll
[*] Survivor airdrop will now always appear away from the cabin
[*] Reduced activation time for ice wall consoles from 3 seconds to 1 second
[*] Removed "don't deal damage with tools" bonus challenge and replaced with individual challenges for not using a single type of tool
[*] Players will now drop batteries if holding one when teleported by the Solar Flare event
[*] Basic mode has its own drop tables for crates, to help reduce the need for crafting (Crates include: Berries, Cooked Animal Meat, Potpie, First Aid Kit, Axe, Pick Axe, Sickle, Campfire Kit, Bear Trap, Shotgun)
[*] Animals drop additional meat when killed. [/list]

[h3][b]BUG FIXES:[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Fixed aiming reticle missing for cloned players when aiming ranged weapons at a valid target
[*] Fixed issues with targeting other players on controller while aiming a ranged weapon if there were any items in the path between the player and target
[*] Fixed armory icon not being shown on map for a cloned soldier in certain cases
[*] Fixed certain cases where game may not end if multiple players disconnect simultaneously
[*] Fixed issue where player could get stuck while using truth serum reveal or Hunter's reveal ability on another player while the other player is downed
[*] Fixed contextual option for Hunter's reveal ability being visible while Hunter is attacking another player
[*] Fixed cabin radio not updating to show "repair tasks first" prompt if an objective is sabotaged after the first escape has been called
[*] Fixed tutorial player not using correct body type
[*] Fixed issue where camera could remain zoomed out and player animations could break when dropping a radio while aiming a ranged weapon
[*] Fixed wolves not correctly consuming dropped meat
[*] Fixed ghost chill and ghost heal being able to affect players onboard an escape if they disembark after the ability has been used
[*] Fixed several cases where environmental sounds could persist between maps
[*] Fixed issue with ranger escape vehicle sometimes not playing audio
[*] Fixed possible connection issues for some players when first loading into game; retry prompt will show less often
[*] Fixed issue with player corpse inventory title not displaying incorrectly in Turkish
[*] Fixed minimap being hidden by Solar Flare event when player is not actually teleported (due to being aboard the escape vehicle or otherwise)
[*] Fixed various issues with map geometry
[*] [Blackout] Fixed cases where ghost animal corpses could remain visible after Witching Hour event had ended
[*] [Xbox] Fixed tooltips on main menu buttons not being positioned correctly
[*] [Xbox] Fixed stacking issues with certain prompts on the main menu
[*] [Xbox] Fixed cases where certain button legends could be incorrect after navigating to and subsequently closing certain popups
[*] [Xbox] Fixed issues with certain controllers disconnecting and reconnecting repeatedly
[*] [Xbox] Fixed issue with transparent overlay displaying on game over screen
[*] [Xbox] Fixed issue where password could not be removed from lobby to unlock it
[*] [Xbox] Fixed debug export button being visible when first opening custom settings menu
[*] [Xbox] Fixed issues with player name verification and duplicate player names not being uniquely identifiable
[*] [Xbox] Fixed Helper Backpack cosmetic item missing textures
[*] [Xbox] Fixed empty slots on character and store screen tabs not being coloured correctly
[*] [Xbox] Fixed various issues with switching between profiles mid-game
[*] [Xbox] Fixed issues with screen tearing[/list]

notes.title: January Housekeeping Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33747333/8b96994e4b66bcb7d9c563e7a5494ad24d2c7531.png[/img]

Happy New Year Survivors!  

After a well-deserved holiday break we are back with another update.  Although somewhat small due to holidays and with us being busy pushing out our newly announced Xbox builds, we still managed to pack in some special surprises!

Add a splash of colour with your betrayal! Enjoy six new hair colours, which you can purchase from the permanent section of the item store, including:
[list][*] Blue
[*] Bright Red
[*] Cyan
[*] Green
[*] Pink
[*] Purple[/list]
The treats don’t end there though! We’ve heard your requests and this month’s steam store items are weapon skins! We’ve added an assortment of new weapon skins for both melee and guns - for all your murdering needs!  


[h3][b]NEW FEATURES & GENERAL CHANGES:[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Added six new hair colours which can be purchased from the permanent section of the item store
[*] Sorting lobbies by status will show open preferred mode lobbies followed by other open lobbies, rather than all preferred mode lobbies first
[*] Various UI updates to make controller navigation more friendly
[*] Added new color variants to cosmetic items in existing crates[/list]

[h3][b]BALANCE CHANGES:[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Reduced pool of available bonus objectives in Basic Mode and reduced requirements for repair material crafting objectives and destroy signs objective
[*] Reduced points for Identity Thief bonus objective from 1000 to 600
[*] Updated “hunt and kill X animals” bonus objective to requirements of 1, 3 or 5 instead of 3 or 5 and change points awarded to 100, 300 and 500 respectively
[*] Reduced points penalty for survivors damaging other survivors from -20 per 100 damage to -5 per 100 damage, and increased penalty for survivors killing other survivors from -100 to -250[/list]

[h3][b]BUG FIXES:[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Fixed issue where progression trees could become locked on subsequent launches after unlocking and purchasing an item
[*] Fixed issue where if several players disconnected around the same time, the may not have ended when a game over condition was met
[*] Fixed issue where players repeatedly interacting with a bunker console could cause the bunker to open without all consoles being activated
[*] Fixed issue where ghosts could be able to spam their fire or feast abilities
[*] Fixed certain cases where flickering could be observed on certain areas of the UI
[*] Fixed escape vehicle not blocking gunshots and allowing players to be shot from the opposite side while boarding
[*] Fixed dig site shovel building counting as a yellow flag for the “visit X yellow flag points” bonus objective
[*] Fixed wind audio from intro playing for longer than it should when skipping cutscene and reaching the main menu quickly
[*] Fixed players cloned while a global exile is active being able to enter the cabin or power station
[*] Fixed escapes spawning in incorrect locations on several maps, leading to issues with animal pathing
[*] Fixed issue where player could be prevented from falling off a sabotaged bridge by standing in the right location
[*] Fixed players being able to loot items through walls of power station from certain angles
[*] Fixed explosion sfx not playing for certain bridges when sabotaged
[*] Fixed various geometry, collision and object placement issues on maps
[*] Fixed text for item store buy button sometimes overlapping
[*] [Blackout] Fixed case where invisible animals could appear during wave console activation if a Witching Hour event had previously occurred and ghost animals were killed during it[/list]

[h3][b]NEW COSMETICS TO EARN[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33747333/da220e3d23cf24afff29ec2fbe8c91c7848e4930.png[/img]

notes.title: December Housekeeping Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33747333/99284322f5caa38bf3a7418064173f44185ef574.png[/img]

Greetings Survivors!

We are back with our monthly update! This update is largely focused on improving existing systems and the overall experience through balance changes and bug fixes.

You will notice the cabin has a little bit of holiday cheer sprinkled over it brought to you by the Project Winter elves - a special festive touch to prepare for the Holiday event happening soon!

This past month we had a community contest in our Discord which resulted in two recommended presets being added in with this update: [i]Who Are You?[/i] and [i]Fool Among Us[/i]. Be sure to check them out and let us know what you think! 

Want to get involved in our next community contest? Join our [url=discord.gg/projectwinter]Discord[/url] to submit and vote in future events!


[h3][b]NEW FEATURES & GENERAL CHANGES:[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Added various holiday-themed decorations in and around the cabin
[*] Player names can now be selected on the game over screen to view the player’s Steam profile
[*] Various updates to UI to improve controller support[/list]

[h3][b]BALANCE CHANGES:[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Reduced health reduction for consuming uncooked berries to 0
[*] Added warmth restoration to cooked food items: 10 for berries, 25 for cooked animal meat and 50 for cooked human heart
[*] Increased range of tripwire alarm from 100 to 250 units
[*] Increased alert time for tripwire from 10 secs to 30 secs
[*] Reduced crafting cost of tripwire to 1 wood, 1 stone (previously 2 wood, 1 stone)
[*] Increased flares received from crafting recipe from 1 to 2
[*] Increased frequency of traitor crates in Basic Mode
[*] Removed animation for claiming bonus objective[/list]

[h3][b]BUG FIXES:[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Fixed cases where an item or interactable object would show “in-use” despite no players being near it
[*] Fixed last equipped item looted from a player who died during mass hysteria event not working correctly
[*] Fixed cases where inventory items could turn black and become unusable for a period of time
[*] Fixed issue where camera could remain zoomed out if player aimed a ranged weapon and swapped inventory items on the same frame
[*] Fixed proximity chat getting cut off if player picked up a radio while holding down the push-to-talk button
[*] Fixed proximity chat control not being able to be rebound
[*] Fixed certain Korean characters not being displayed correctly
[*] Fixed new item indicators not appearing correctly when hairstyle or beard cosmetics were purchased
[*] Fixed issue where warmth gain from cabin could continue to apply if leaving cabin when mega blizzard starts
[*] Fixed collectible batteries sometimes not respawning when dropped off a sabotaged bridge
[*] Fixed issue on main menu when exiting lobbies where unnecessary data would be downloaded in the background
[*] Fixed points not being awarded if player force closes game while on game over screen
[*] Fixed cases for new players where cosmetic items could display incorrectly for their character on MVP screen or when selecting character customization tab on main menu
[*] Fixed case where hot springs ambient audio could persist between matches
[*] Fixed placement of traitor hatch on main tile to prevent it from appearing inside power station
[*] Fixed case where crafted items dropped on ground due to full inventory would not be seen by other players
[*] Fixed gamepad name being blank if a controller is plugged in and the player has opened the settings screen more than once in the same session
[*] Fixed several instances of text that wasn’t translated
[*] Fixed various visual issues and collision problems on maps
[*] [Blackout] Fixed consoles for certain wolf bunkers being interactable after the bunker has been opened[/list]

[h3][b]NEW COSMETICS TO EARN[/b][/h3]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33747333/778e079d2f72c02ca7c8d217e7acc4552a8552d8.png[/img]

[h3][b]Keep your feedback coming![/b][/h3]
As always, we are listening and we encourage everyone to leave feedback in our community [url=discord.gg/projectwinter]Discord[/url] in the #suggestions channel.

Stay tuned for more updates in the future, and thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: November Housekeeping Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33747333/bf942ea926374d4f16ae0e44de5749c38cbd504e.png[/img]

Hello Survivors!

Today we present you with a housekeeping update!

Tired of trying to find poison around the map? Fret no more! Poison is now craftable with 1 fuel and 1 herb! You can now also craft a new item - poisoned first-aid kits! Be careful though as the traitors will have access to this as well…

With the addition of more customizability options within our custom game mode during the last update, we only saw fit to add in the option for saved game presets! Pick from recommended presets uploaded by the devs or save your favourite match settings to play again later!

We’re excited to see what custom presets you all create and the mayhem that will surely ensue!

Please note that we are in the process of overhauling how we load the game. This should give us better performance in loading times, but may result in some unforeseen bugs.  If you notice something please contact us through our [url=discord.gg/projectwinter]Discord[/url] in the #report-bugs channel.

[h3][b]NEW FEATURES & GENERAL CHANGES:[/b][/h3]

Custom game settings changes:
[list][*] Added setting to control the first and second objective types
[*] Added setting to cause game to end when all traitors have died
[*] Added setting to control the difficulty of the repair and animal wave objective types
[*] Added setting to control the rate at which traitors gain credits from being near survivors
[*] Presets: players can now save their settings as presets via a new tab on the custom game settings screen. Up to 10 presets can be stored, and players can also choose from a selection of recommended presets that have their settings locked, giving players joining from the lobby browser an easy way to see what kind of custom game they’re joining.[/list]
Various changes to the poisoning mechanic:
[list][*] Poison is now craftable for 1 fuel and 1 herb
[*] Poisoned first-aid kits can be crafted with 1 first-aid kit and 1 poison
[*] All forms of poison except the poison crossbow now reduce all stats by 10% when applied
[*] Reduced duration from poisoned foods and interactables from 60 to 30 secs
[*] Hunger loss from poison now happens each time player vomits, rather than immediately[/list]
[list][*] Herb bushes no longer have collision, will instead slow the player while they’re moving through them
[*] All regular bunkers will now have one console only when playing a solo custom match so they can be opened more easily
[*] Added a new info box to custom game lobbies that will indicate whether players will be eligible to earn progress in achievements, unlock tasks, etc. (if there are at least 5 players and a minimum of 1 traitor or more in the custom settings)
[*] Updated terminology for sabotage actions: “break” is now used for actions that will permanently affect the sabotaged object for the rest of the match, while “sabotage” indicates a temporary effect
[*] Added new caution signs on rock walls map indicating presence of white wolves ⚠️🐺⚠️
[*] Player downed timer will now pause while mass hysteria event transition is active
[*] “Craft a backpack” achievement has been renamed “obtain a backpack” and will now complete when a backpack is stolen from a player corpse
[*] Changed colour of stat bars when stats are permanently reduced from their initial values
[*] Added several additional tips to the loading screen[/list][/list]
Controller navigation improvements: 
[list][*] Current selected element will now flash 
[*] You can now jump from one side to the other side when viewing item containers[/list]

[h3][b]BALANCE CHANGES:[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Reduced stats restored by uncooked food items and increased stats restored for most cooked food items
[*] Respawn timer for berry bushes has been doubled (from 150 to 300 sec)[/list]

Bunker sabotage changes:
[list][*] All regular bunkers will now be permanently locked when sabotaged, rather than being on a timer; contextual action now reads “break” to reflect this
[*] These bunkers can now be broken in advance by spending 4 traitor credits, causing the bunker to permanently lock instead of open when all of its consoles are activated; this option is available when none of the other consoles are currently activated
[*] When at least one other console is activated for a breakable bunker, a free break option that mimics the existing sabotage option will be shown; this functions the same and causes the bunker to permanently lock when all consoles are activated
[*] For special bunkers (lab, armory, cipher, etc.), the existing functionality will be retained[/list]
Hot springs changes: 
[list][*] Updated visuals for console to make it clearer it can be interacted with
[*] Sabotage now costs 2 credits and can be done in advance, causing any subsequent activations of the hot springs to deal damage and apply warmth over a shorter period of time
[*] Sabotaged damage increased from 250 to 500 total
[*] Non-sabotaged duration increased from 20 to 40 seconds and increased warmth restoration to 500 total to match sabotaged values[/list]
[list]
[*] Sabotaging the cabin radio prior to the first escape being called will now also cause the backup escape to be sabotaged as well
[*] Points awarded for performing sabotages are now based on the number of traitor credits spent
[*] Reduced frequency of poison items in traitor crates
[*] Lookout tower bunkers now contain better items [/list]

[h3][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where rebinding left and right mouse buttons would prevent the player from being able to attack or aim (those actions now be re-bound)
[*] Fixed players losing points for repairing or stealing parts from repair objective if they are converted later in the match
[*] Fixed minimap reappearing for a frame after solar flare teleport happens
[*] Fixed hitbox of Tarot Reader Staff
[*] Fixed certain items not being hidden correctly when previewing them in the item store; filtering will now work the same as it does on the character customization screen so the visual displayed on the item store screen will always be accurate
[*] Fixed case where as the host player, another player disconnecting could cause issues with your character such as your items becoming briefly unusable
[*] Fixed backpack not being craftable after being cloned if one had been crafted beforehand
[*] Fixed backpack not being removed from crafting menu if player has stolen a backpack
[*] Fixed health of cloned players not scaling correctly when playing a custom match
[*] Fixed timeline entry not appearing for players killed by standing under the helicopter as it’s landing
[*] Fixed moose on main tile not having their health properly scale in custom games
[*] Fixed countdown timer for events not updating after initial launch of the game
[*] Fixed case where players could get stuck on game over screen if network call to calculate their score fails
[*] Fixed case where players would not be correctly kicked out of a match if the host disconnected during the initial load, causing the match to become broken for the remaining players
[*] Fixed mismatched console colour for one surprise bunker
[*] Fixed network data settings to hopefully reduce number of disconnects
[*] Fixed various terrain issues[/list]
Fixed Controller Issues:
[list][*] Navigation of player inventory slots when opening a container for the first time.
[*] A highlighted element getting stuck visually when opening a container for the first time.
[*] Top left element having a larger item icon than the rest in containers. 
[*] Radial menu now has a tolerance when selecting elements. 

[*] [Blackout] Fixed certain cases where invisible wolves could appear [/list]

[h3][b]NEW COSMETICS TO EARN [/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33747333/c3e426c78e778977849fb37f424a6b9f85cc8566.png[/img]

[h3][b]Keep your feedback coming![/b][/h3]

As always, we are listening and we encourage everyone to leave feedback in our community [url=discord.gg/projectwinter]Discord[/url] in the #suggestions channel.

Stay tuned for more updates in the future, and thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Back to Basics Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33747333/30579203fd0ca41ad3b0ff78461db526b603f4c4.png[/img]

Hello Survivors!

Today we have some exciting news. A new game mode! We are introducing a [u][b]Basic Mode[/b][/u] for new players learning the game and for seasoned players who want more simplified gameplay. The mode will include shorter rounds, a smaller map, a simplified ruleset, and no additional roles. 

For those who like to spice things up, we also added more to the custom game mode! Enjoy a wealth of choices for how you want to enjoy your Project Winter experience. Have less than 5 players, control escape vehicle capacities, timer limits, a larger range for the number of traitors in the game, and so much more! 

[h3][b]NEW FEATURES & GENERAL CHANGES[/b][/h3]
[b]Basic Mode added![/b] This is a new game mode designed to help first-time players ease into the main game mode or provide an alternative for veterans looking for a more fast-paced, streamlined game mode. It includes the following features: 

[list]
[*] 15 minute rounds
[*] Smaller four-quadrant map
[*] Repair objectives only
[*] No additional roles (survivor and traitor only)
[*] Only blizzard global events
[*] No armory or truth serum lab
[*] Reduced pool of bonus objectives
[*] Reduced set of crafting recipes available
[*] Advanced items (combat stimulants, flares, etc.) no longer appear in crates
[/list]

[b]Custom Game changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Minimum player limit for starting a match is now disabled for custom matches (players will not be eligible to earn points when playing with fewer than 5 or with no traitors)
[*] Minimum/maximum traitor sliders can now be set from 0 to 7, respectively (note these settings may be ignored to ensure one survivor is always present in the match)
[*] Game duration slider can now be set as low as 15 minutes
[*] Added new settings for disabling the truth serum lab or armory
[*] Added new setting for controlling whether berry bushes should respawn
[*] Added new settings for changing the traitor airdrop timers
[*] Added new setting for controlling escape vehicle capacity
[*] Added new setting to control whether power lines leading to second objective should be visible or not
[*] Custom game settings for the current match can now be viewed from the in-game ESC menu
[*] Hovering over the custom game icon in lobby browser will now only reveal settings that are changed (to make it easier to read)
[*] Updated various parts of the main menu play tab UI to go along with the addition of basic mode:
[*] Lobby browser now allows players to select a preferred game mode, which will display its description on the left and sort all lobbies of that type to the top of the browser window
[*] The host game and quick match buttons will now display a new game mode selection screen to specify which type of lobby you want to create or join
[*] The lobby screen design has been updated to be colour-coded based on the game mode of the lobby
[*] Removed option for Classic Mode on host game popup. This can still be played via a custom game with player roles disabled and all other settings left unchanged
[*] Locked lobby filter option in lobby browser now saves and persists between matches and subsequent launches of the game
[*] Added new cosmetic rarity colour for items purchased with artifacts, and improved cosmetic sorting to show newest items first for each rarity tier
[*] Improved UI for showing when escape vehicle has been sabotaged via the cabin radio
[*] Players speaking over the proximity voice channel will now have their indicators in the lower left fade based on their distance from your player
[*] Added crafting recipe item icons to tooltips of items that can be crafted or cooked
[*] Added additional messaging on the repair objectives UI to better inform new players of how to repair them
[*] Added new location indicators for most buildings and removed location indicators for environmental areas
[*] Mega blizzard notifications text updated to show timer and better indicate the mega blizzard is not immediately starting
[*] Updated visuals of tutorial page of game guide and removed video tutorial
[*] Added new message to the launch splash screens to emphasize that voice communication is recommended for playing the game
[*] Refreshed gameplay tips that appear on loading screen and reduced the time it takes for them to cycle
[*] Improved security for voice chat features
[/list]

[h3][b]BALANCE CHANGES:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased radius of effect for hot springs activation and sabotage
[*] Increased number of seats removed from sabotaging the escape vehicle for lower survivor counts
[/list]

[h3][b]BUG FIXES:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed dying in areas where warmth changes at different rate (cabin, in water, etc.) continuing to apply if player is cloned later in the match
[*] Fixed issue where player’s items could darken and briefly becoming unusable if a ghost player disconnected under certain circumstances
[*] Fixed various areas where alternate keybinds weren’t being scaled for correctly on the UI
[*] Fixed various issues with controller navigation and button colours not being consistent with the rest of the UI
[*] Fixed solar flare audio not stopping if game ends while it’s triggering
[*] Fixed dragged player corpses being released too easily
[*] Fixed text elements not appearing on radial wheel when running at 4K resolution
[*] Fixed odd behavior of animals patrolling near steep slopes in the terrain (notably a bear near the canyon)
[*] Fixed host game popup being left on screen after an invite was accepted, if it was enabled
[*] Fixed menu screen becoming black if disconnection occurs during fade-out to playable tutorial
[*] Fixed investigate option showing on player corpses when roles are not enabled (as this provides no information unless there can be a detective present)
[*] Fixed points earned or lost for stealing resources from repair consoles awarding double the intended value
[*] Fixed players killed via bridge sabotage awarding points for survivors stopped in addition to survivors killed for the sabotaging traitor
[*] Fixed issue where player could be teleported into and trapped in a tree from solar flare event
[*] Fixed various map issues where players could get stuck in terrain or animals would behave improperly
[*] Fixed sabotaging cabin radio incrementing the “escapes called” stat
[*] Fixed issue where being downed while dragging a body was not releasing the body from being dragged for other clients
[*] Fixed cases where players could get stuck on a bridge that was repaired after a sabotage
[*] Fixed first-aid kits counting as crafted items rather than cooked items on stats page
[*] Fixed non-recyclable items not returning to correct colour when recycle mode is disabled
[*] Fixed traitors not receiving additional points for sabotaging an objective more than once
[*] [Blackout] Fixed issue where druid fire was too bright when player was near it as a ghost
[*] [Blackout] Fixed portal animation not resetting properly for players who’ve escaped and returned to the portal as a ghost
[/list]
[h3][b]
Keep your feedback coming![/b][/h3]

We are eager to see the new gameplay these changes will bring! As always, we are listening and we encourage everyone to leave feedback in our community [url=discord.gg/projectwinter]Discord[/url] in the #suggestions channel.

Stay tuned for more updates in the future, and thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: We're Still Listening!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33747333/c301c1b7ddcbe4ef21384a7bf43dcf41e139a277.png[/img]

Hello again, survivors.

As you may know, the team recently compiled a list of feedback from the community Discord and put them up to a vote as to which issues are most pressing. Today is the day that we release these changes into the Project Winter wild. We think that many of you will enjoy our most recent update. 

As always, we are still listening! We encourage everyone to leave feedback at-will in our community [url=discord.gg/projectwinter]Discord[/url] in the #suggestions channel. We will certainly do more feedback round-ups in the future as we strive to make the changes you want to see.

[h3]It is official, the outhouse door can now be closed.[/h3]

In other news, we’ve done our best to even out proximity chat to ensure that players hear each other more consistently while in-range, made some more balance changes, and added a new custom lobby option. Of course, we’ve also scrubbed out a few bugs that were brought to light by the players. 

[h3][b]NEW FEATURES & GENERAL CHANGES[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Custom games can now specify the min and max counts for each type of role in the base game in addition to the min and max traitor counts
[*] Custom games settings button in lobby will display an exclamation badge until the next it is pressed if the custom game settings have been updated by the host
[*] Adjusted positioning and volume scaling of player proximity voice range. The radius for another player to be heard at max volume has been reduced by 75%, while the scaling is now more gradual so players will be more noticeably quiet at a distance. The positioning has also been adjusted so that players further south will no longer be easier to hear at a distance than players to the north.
[*] Backpacks can now be looted from player corpses
[*] Added timeline event to indicate which player initiated the escape vehicle leave sequence
[*] Added new bonus objective for visiting multiple flag points during a match
[*] Tranquilizer gun can now slow animals in addition to players
[/list]

[h3][b]BALANCE CHANGES[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased points earned for most survivor repair actions (contributing repair parts, digging up items, delivering batteries and opening cipher bunkers)
[*] Increased threshold for ”survive and take less than X damage from players” bonus objective from 600 to 1000 damage
[*] Increased reward for “survive and take less than X damage from players”, “survive without dealing damage with ranged weapons or explosives” and “survive without dealing damage with tools” bonus objectives from 400 to 500 survivor points
[*] Reduced tranquilizer gun ammo count from 5 to 3, reduced damage to 0, increased aiming speed by 100%, increased tranquilized effect duration to 20 seconds and increased slow from 50% to 60% of based speed
[*] Increased pieces of information revealed for Detective on investigation screen from 3 to 5
[*] Reduced traitor credits cost for cabin radio sabotage from 10 to 5
[*] Proximity traitor credits meter will now begin to drain after being out of range of survivors for several seconds rather than immediately emptying
[/list]

[h3][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where animals could occasionally move at much higher speeds than normal if the host of a lobby disconnects mid-game
[*] Fixed issue where players muted in a lobby would sometimes not remain muted after loading into a match or after leaving and rejoining the lobby
[*] Fixed issue where melee weapons could sometimes not be equipped after being looted from a player corpse
[*] Fixed issue where minimap could remain visible after solar flare event teleport if player enters cabin just prior to teleport occurring
[*] Fixed neutral role players awarding “survivors stopped” points if the game ends while they are still alive
[*] Fixed custom game settings button in lobby not adjusting position after clicking on another player in the lobby and seeing the player options dropdown
[*] Fixed error message that could appear after cancelling out of the custom game settings screen from the host game popup and then reopening it
[*] Fixed various issues with controller navigation
[*] Fixed several issues where player could clip into or get stuck in environment objects
[*] Fixed apply and revert buttons being visible on custom game settings screen when pressed from within a lobby while not the host of the lobby
[*] Fixed cases where damage to animals may not be reflected correctly if the host has disconnected
[*] Fixed issues with ordering of certain popups on main menu
[*] Fixed player count in lobby sometimes not reflecting the correct number of players
[*] Fixed traitor credits indicator remaining visible for dead traitors cloned into survivors
[*] Fixed issue where items on breakable bridges would sometimes not fall after bridge was sabotage
[*] Fixed particle effects on items being briefly visible where the item was previously positioned if it was dropped in one location, picked up and then equipped in a different one
[*] [Blackout] Fixed issue where Whisperer converts would not correctly join the red radio channel if they were converted while already holding a radio and later dropped it
[/list]

[h3][b]NEW COSMETICS TO EARN[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33747333/3f30d78d13e9af0d3347486dcf30af5101f9eb4c.png[/img]

Remember, no matter how tempted you may be, you won’t be able to fit the entire lobby into one outhouse.

Stay tuned for more updates in the future.

notes.title: Special Assignment: Search and Seizure
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33747333/b189d6ff75dd294b736e0011675ee0904037e999.png[/img]

Survivors, a new research assignment has been sent from the sea labs HQ.

We’ve been tasked with gathering as much intel about the local zone as possible. We’re looking for natural anomalies, landscape features, and an assortment of equipment that has survived the storms.

We’ve annexed a document listing all items of interest below. Each item has a particular value to the labs crew, so different submissions may earn a different amount of credit to the participant.

Participants are required to capture photos of as many priority items as possible at once. The more items captured in one image, the higher value the image is worth.

[h2]Rules[/h2]

[list]
[*] Community guidelines still apply
[*] Participants must follow the community guidelines, failing to do so will disqualify you from the event. Find them [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/774861/discussions/0/1777136225045778109/]here[/url].
[*] All event submissions must be through an in-game screenshot.
[*] No alternate forms of submission will be accepted. 
[*] 3 screenshot limit
[*] You may delete submitted screenshots to resubmit one with a higher score.
[*] Participants’ Steam account must be linked to their Discord Account.
     Exceptions can be made, direct message RedFive (thomas4good#4074) on discord.
[*] All screenshots must be taken in a standard, non-custom, public game of Project Winter.
[*] Screenshots must be unique
[*] You cannot take more than 1 screenshot per game.
[*] You cannot submit screenshots with identical inventories

notes.title: Feature Feedback Roundup #2
notes.notes:
Greetings again, survivors!

We're back with another feedback roundup. Considering recent requests in our suggestions channels, we have rounded up some of the most voted suggestions and posted them as stickied comments in  [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/Project_Winter/comments/ibhrsa/reddit_feedback_roundup_2/]this Reddit thread[/url]. We've altered point gains to better reflect the contributions of a player during their match, including types of escape, objectives, and new categories as well. Likewise, we've buffed a few aspects of the Traitor role as well.

As always, we want to thank any players who posted their feedback and suggestions to our official discord. We've been doing our best to funnel your feedback into our development timeline, and we hope we've addressed some of the more recent concerns.

[*] All traitors will now passively earn traitor credits while in proximity to non-traitor players, scaling with the number of players the traitor is near and represented by a new charge ring around the traitor credits icon in the upper left of the HUD. [*] Emote wheel has been updated to allow players to construct basic phrases and send them via text chat in addition to displaying emotes

notes.title: Elementary, my dear Traitor
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33747333/c6609f9db88d6ab3f4568be8558c18657b1abc8a.png[/img]

[h2]Elementary, my dear Traitor[/h2]

Beware, survivors. This body is still warm... There's a killer about. It appears the weapon of choice was a pickaxe.

Grab your thinking caps and fanciest pipes; this newest role should add some more depth to your survival strategies. Welcome the newest role: The Detective!

Players can now examine player corpses to reveal details about their death. For most players, these details will be hidden. For the Detective, however, three of the seven available details will be revealed. Use this to investigate and deduce information about the killer on the loose!

[h3]FEATURES AND GENERAL CHANGES[/h3]

[list]
[*] Bonus objectives overhaul: all objectives for survivors and traitors are now chosen from a generic pool of approximately 30 objectives, with no class-specific limitations. Various existing objectives have been removed and replaced with more neutral and gameplay-focused objectives. The Yeti will now choose from a subset of these objectives, and will no longer have the chance to share the same objective as another player.
[*] New cabin radio sabotage ability: when the escape is available to be called at the radio, traitors can now spend 10 credits to sabotage it, reducing the number of seats available by 50%. This can be done for both the first and second escape vehicles.
[*] New cabin signpost sabotage ability: traitors can now sabotage the signposts pointing to the cabin for 1 credit, causing them to spin and point in a different direction.
[*] Mechanics for red radios updated: red radios are no longer a physical item, instead being usable by traitors while they are not carrying a blue or yellow radio. When a radio item is added to the radio slot, the traitor will be disconnected from the red radio channel and join the new colour channel instead, and vice-versa when the radio item is removed.
[*] Increased timer duration from 1 minute to 5 minutes for first objective indicator that appears after visiting map, and change indicator icon to match icon shown on map
[*] Increased outfit set slots from 5 to 10
[*] Reduced cooldown for ghost teleport from 3 seconds to 1 second
[/list]

[*] Traitors will now see the survivor roles menu as soon as the game starts instead of after the objective UI is revealed

notes.title: Have You Played… Project Winter?
notes.notes:
Have You Played? is an endless stream of game retrospectives. One a day, every day, perhaps for all time.

I really like Project Winter, at least in theory. It’s a classic hidden role multiplayer affair, where you’re ostensibly Doing A Survival: there’s a bunch of you stuck somewhere arctic, trying not to freeze or starve in a log cabin while also accomplishing tasks like repairing radio transmitters, with the eventual aim of summoning an escape helicopter.

But as Matt put it in a recent post, “really it’s about luring your friends into the wilderness so you can murder them“. Because of course, not all of your group of survivors are goodies. One or two of you, depending on how many are playing, will be secretly designated as gits, and will spend the whole game trying to ruin everyone elses’ chances of rescue.

(more…)

[h2]Greetings once again, survivors.[/h2]

We decided it was time for some additions to the survivors’ arsenal. Our latest update comes with a “new bag of tricks” to play with. This brand new set of items can be found like others, and offer a variety of tactics to survivors and traitors alike. Experiment with them and expand your playstyle!

As usual, we’ve taken your feedback into consideration and made a few notable balance changes that we hope will make each game feel a bit better. 

In other news, we’ve integrated Discord with our lobby system! Players can now post invites to their game lobbies as a Discord message through the app or overlay. Likewise, the engineering team has been hard at work fixing up issues, some of which were found and reported by you. We thank you for your continued support as we iron out the wrinkles.

[h3][b]FEATURES AND CHANGES[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] New item: Explosive Crossbow. Can be found exclusively in the armory and from the loot drop event crate. Fires bolts that explode on impact, damaging and ragdolling players within range.
[*] New item: Flare. Can be crafted or found in bunker crates. When thrown will ignite and display a location marker for all players at its position for two minutes.
[*] New item: Quick Disarm Kit. Can be crafted (3 per recipe) or found in bunker crates. If a player is holding one in their inventory when stepping in a bear trap, it will be consumed and significantly reduce the duration of the trap.
[*] New item: Stimulants. Can be found in bunker crates. When consumed, temporarily increases your movement speed and physical damage by 15% for 30 seconds before decreasing them by 20% for 15 seconds after the primary effect wears off.
[*] New item: Tripwire. Can be crafted (2 per recipe) or found in bunker crates. When deployed, will sound an alarm and display a location indicator for 10 seconds to players in the vicinity. Can also be used to trap interactable objects to trigger the same effect the next time they’re interacted with.
[*] Added support for sending game invites through Discord. Host or join a lobby, and switch back to Discord/Open Discord overlay. You should now see a green play icon next to the (+) button on the left side of your Discord chat bar.
[*] Added a new tutorial prompt on the results screen to explain the social ranking system
[*] Fuel can now be used to restore warmth for campfires (with an explosive side-effect!)
[*] Main menu progression tab now uses your character to display the progression items instead of fixed body types
[*] Community guidelines on main menu are now localized for all supported languages
[*] Added Turkish and Greek language support
[/list]

[*] Reduced frequency of guns in traitor airdrops and increased frequency of gun parts

notes.title: I can't stop giggling about being a traitorous arse in Project Winter
notes.notes:
“So how are you doing, Matt?” asks Brendy (RPS in peace). We’re foraging together, well out of earshot from the other survivors. “I mean outside the game”, he says. “How’s your shoulder? Is your collarbone healing OK?”. It’s been a while since we chatted, and I genuinely appreciate his concern. It’s a nice moment. I tell him I’m doing just fine, while simultaneously raising my sickle.

“Feels a bit weird to do this now, though” I said, as I brought it down on him.

Project Winter is a survival game about escaping a frozen wilderness, except really it’s about luring your friends into the wilderness so you can murder them. We played it nonstop for most of last weekend, and I have rarely laughed so hard at a videogame.

(more…)

notes.title: Can You Dig It?
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33747333/559a4b517fbae491f7e07a892f204728ab41e02c.png[/img]

Hey everyone! We've got another update for you today.

Known as the "Can You Dig It?" update, this release includes a new objective and some more global events to keep things fresh.

[b]NEW OBJECTIVE[/b]: Scavenge newly added dig-sites for special components to repair the power station. Use some photographed intelligence provided at the power station to identify and locate these components to progress through the first objective.

[b]NEW GLOBAL EVENTS[/b]: Three new events have been added for some fresh experiences and even more winter pandemonium.

[i]Solar Flares[/i]: Freakish weather culminates and intensifies before suddenly transporting players to random areas scattered around the map. Not only that, but the flare will scramble your navigation, breaking your minimap until you can find your way back to the cabin to repair it.

[i]Spreading Madness[/i]: Bouts of madness infiltrate a random player's mind. As the player slips deeper into insanity, they will find themselves becoming gradually more affected by their madness. Distance yourself from others; if you spend too much time with an affected player, their paranoid rambling will cause you to lose your sanity as well.

[i]Seed of Insanity[/i]: Similar to the Spreading Madness event, one player is randomly chosen. This time, however, the player will show no adverse effects, but will still slowly begin to drive other players mad.  Only this player will have an affect on others, so be sure to identify them as soon as possible and isolate them before your whole team loses their minds!

[b]GENERAL CHANGES[/b]: 
[list]
[*]Ghosts are no longer restricted while teleporting. They can now teleport from anywhere and land directly next to the target player, instead of being placed outside if the target is in a building.
[*]Crossbow projectiles no longer stick to target (or appear to stick in the air). Flight physics for projectiles will also be more accurate.
[/list]

[b]NEW COSMETICS[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33747333/c32c07ad35fa01eeeeb065d2ec63a230c8b8b0ad.png[/img]

[b]BALANCE CHANGES[/b]:
[list]
[*] Increased charge time for throwing an item to 1.5 seconds. Damage and range of the throw now scale linearly with the charge percentage, with full charge having the same range and damage as each item had previously.
[*]Low hunger will now reduce the effectiveness of physical attacks (melee, throwing) by up to 30%. This penalty scales linearly from the point the hunger bar turns red up to when it’s fully empty.
[*]Pot Pies now provide a permanent boost to warmth and hunger when eaten (5% and 10%, respectively) in addition to the stats they restore, stacking up to 5 times.
[*]Reduced the probability of a survivor being revived as a traitor in the cloning machine. The cloning machine can now also be sabotaged to guarantee a traitor will always be revived as a traitor.
[*]Armory containers will now contain 1-2 energy drinks (lowest tier) in addition to their existing loot, and have a slightly higher chance of containing a trap disarm kit.
[*]Trap disarm kit area is now positioned in front of the player rather than centered on them, and radius has been reduced by 20%
[*]Landmine explosions now have a reduced area for ragdolling players. Players further away from the blast radius will take the same damage they would previously, but be slowed briefly instead of ragdolled.
[*]Reduced delay between the bear’s area of effect attack and when they begin attacking again.
[*]Damage can now be dealt to resource nodes if a landmine explodes near them.
[*]Armory icon will no longer display on the map for traitors when playing with roles disabled.
[/list]

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]:
[list]
[*]Fixed issue where ghosts could communicate over radio channels if the push-to-talk key was held while swapping channels.
[*]Fixed crossbow bolts sometimes causing the player hit to pop into the air.
[*]Fixed armory bunker requiring a traitor to operate the special console when roles are disabled (can now be operated by any player).
[*]Fixed text wrapping for certain UI elements when controls are bound to different keys.
[*]Fixed shotgun effectiveness against downed players being lower than it should have been (can once again take a maximum of 10 seconds off the revive timer with a full hit).
[*]Fixed cases where item tooltips could remain visible or be hidden when they shouldn’t be.
[*]Fixed case where player could become unable to move if the esc menu is opened immediately after being ragdolled and left open until the player stands back up.
[*]Fixed some cases where “NOT FOUND” would display on timeline kill cards.
[*]Fixed cloning machine not reviving players if their ghost was inside a structure.
[*]Fixed cases where animals would ignore non-host players when they entered a yellow flag area.
[*]Fixed open bunkers ability on survivor airdrop being usable multiple times.
[*][Blackout] Fixed cabin becoming accessible during the blackout event if a global exile that had been triggered prior to it starting ends.
[*][Blackout] Fixed placed traps being hidden when a converted survivor is promoted to Whisperer.
[*][Blackout] Fixed Whisperer not being able to convert cloned players until they had entered and exited the cabin at least once.
[*][Blackout] Fixed case where conversion bars could occasionally appear on dead bodies.
[*][Blackout] Fixed portal and DSRV escapes showing the wrong icon on escape departed banner notification.

notes.title: Lie to your friends in Project Winter, the best bullshitting sim on PC
notes.notes:
You've got to suspend friendships to play certain games. Street Fighter can generate lasting resentments when players fail to temporarily turn off friend-mode, fume about whatever cheap-ass bullshit their momentary non-friend has put up, and then reactivate friendly relations once their scrub rage has passed. As a teenager, I stormed out of a friend's house over such a case of Street Fighter 2 bullshit.

Project Winter is much more insidious. It isn't cheesy move spamming that hurts you, it's the lies. Among your group of eight survivors—and I highly recommend playing with people you know—two are traitors. As a survivor, not only do you have to avoid being killed or set back by the traitors, you have to survive a frigid, moose and bear-infested wilderness, which is hard enough without liars among you.

It's another attempt at bringing the basic concept of party game Werewolf—you may know it by its Mafia variant—into a multiplayer videogame. It's a tough thing to do. For one, everyone has to play along. It's no fun if the secret traitors just say "haha, I'm a traitor" at the start. And two, the full experience of sitting in a circle trying to suss out liars among your friends can't be replicated in a game, at least until mainstream VR accurately reproduces facial expressions and body language.

Project Winter's adaption succeeds by replacing face-to-face communication with lots of subtle ways for the traitors to hinder the survivors, which also gives the survivors lots of subtle hints as to who the traitors are. The top-down view means that, if you can't see someone on your screen, they can't see you, giving traitors privacy when they want to open special, traitor-only crates that contain weapons, traps, and poisons. But if a survivor stumbles upon an open traitor crate, they may remember who it was that wandered up that way "looking for berries." 

Or not. There's a lot to keep track of outside of sussing out rats. The survivors have to first get a power station up and running, which means looting or crafting materials to drop into it. The traitors usually help during this stage to avoid being found out. Meanwhile, hunger and cold are eating at everybody, and there's not much time to dedicate to interrogating your temporary non-friends about their whereabouts and intentions. And when players are cut off from each other—the area voice chat only carries so far—stories begin to conflict.

In one game, as a traitor, I was called out by a survivor who noticed that I'd left valuable resources sitting in a crate instead of shepherding them to the power station. Rather than protest, I simply walked away and found two other survivors who'd gone on an expedition to find the next objective. 

When I returned with the two of them, who'd seen or heard none of this, this nosy survivor was still on about how I was probably a traitor. I claimed not to have any idea what he was talking about, and accused him of being a traitor, since clearly I'd been helping these other two while he threw accusations around.

To my surprise, my party backed me up. It worked for a little bit, but I tend to crack under pressure given long enough. I'd make a terrible spy.

More often than not I'm the one being fooled. In one game, while warming up inside the starting cabin with two other players, we heard an argument outside. Two players were shouting toward the cabin that the other was the traitor. One had tried to kill the other. No, it was actually an accident. One had said he was the traitor. No, he was joking. Naturally, the three of us in the cabin figured we were witnessing two traitors trying to throw us off by feigning discord. We banished them, and let them kill each other in the cold.

Of course, I'd been warming up with the two real traitors the whole time. Bastards.

Traitors can sabotage access panels to loot bunkers, drop traps, play sneaky games with walkie-talkies—the only way to communicate over distances—encourage risky treks and then run back to the cabin claiming to have gotten 'lost,' and all sorts of other devious things. The best games see a combination of tricks. The worst see the traitors play it too safe at first, so that they have no choice but to pull out guns late in the game and chase the survivors around. That's still fun, though.

Project Winter is one of the few games where I don't mind spectating if I die early. As a ghost, I can teleport around the map to watch everyone else struggle—sometimes overhearing them wonder if I'm still out there, or if I died, or if I was a traitor. Sometimes I know who one of the traitors is—because she killed me—but can't tell them directly. I can only provide ghostly healing, heat, or damage according to what I think I know, and hope they observe my indirect communication. Watching the remaining survivors struggle while having more information than them makes for excellent drama.

I'm sure there's fun to be had with the right group of strangers, but so far I've only played Project Winter with people I know. The post-game chats ("Oh, that's what happened to you!") are one of the best parts of it—just so long as you're able to reinstate friendship-mode after being poisoned to death by a filthy liar.

Hey everyone, we’re dropping our holiday update just in time to help you get into the festive spirit! We’re also bringing in some new game features, such as additional objectives and a brand new store that introduces an entirely different currency system! 

[u][b]FEATURES[/b][/u]

[b]New Store[/b]: Introducing our new store which will feature a new type of currency that will be harder to obtain compared to our usual SP. This currency can be used to buy a selection of new cosmetics in the store, our monthly updated Steam store cosmetics, and special unvaulted items that will come from our catalogue of past items. Make sure to spend your currency wisely! 

[b]New Primary and Secondary Objectives[/b]: We’ve switched things up a bit :) Primary and secondary objectives now have a wider variety of different objects that can appear, plus the introduction of a new secondary objective in which survivors must hunt down three batteries to power up the escape. 

[b]New Holiday Event[/b]: The new holiday event includes decorations across the map, a limited time crate and a new progression tree to unlock. 

[b]General Stability and Bug Fixes[/b]: See the patch notes below to get all the information on our stability changes and bug fixes for this update.

[b]Steam Store Items[/b]: We are also refreshing our Steam store items along with this update, we have 10 new items with colour variations!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33747333/9d8e6f0fd7288aa704d0a64718197fed01a9843d.jpg[/img]

[u][b]BALANCE CHANGES[/b][/u]

[*] Poison Crossbow Changes: stun from vomit effect is now much quicker (approx. 25% of original duration) and only triggers when player is first hit, not randomly for the duration of the poison effect. Duration of poison effect also reduced from 20 secs to 15 secs.
[*] Traitors now have a new HUD element displaying the survivor roles present in the current match, which replaces the icons being visible on the individual survivor nameplates.
[/list]

[u][b]FIXES[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed survival points not being awarded when quitting to main menu via results screen after dying
[*] Fixed player being able to move before they should after opening a sabotaged crate or other object that opens an inventory UI

[*] Fixed case where having the emote wheel open and dismissing it after your character gets knocked down could let you move before you should be able to
[*] Fixed vomit pfx appearing from your character after taking a traitor hatch or disembarking from escape vehicle after being poisoned and having vomit trigger at least once
[*] Fixed vomit effect no longer triggering if player takes a traitor hatch while poisoned
[*] Fixed case where vomit effect for host player could stop triggering if they were poisoned and cured it with a medkit
[*] Removed some redundant information pop-ups appearing in-game which are now covered by the tutorial

[*] Fixed issue where pressing the escape key multiple times on the opening splash screens could cause an error popup to appear
[*] Fixed results screen not appearing when the appropriate button is pressed on a controller
[*] Fixed controller mapping screen labels not being localized
[*] Fixed snowball sounds being audible on main menu when not in interactive lobby
[*] Fixed cabin chest opening on its own when a game starts (causing the opening sound to play in the background)
[*] Fixed various issues and added new optimizations for animal AI
[*] Fixed contextual actions for a player corpse not immediately reappearing after performing the clothes swap action
[*] Fixed issue with certain boot cosmetics where pants colour would reset when they are equipped
[*] Fixed various cases where crates in bunkers could be accessed from outside
[*] Fixed various clipping issues with cosmetics
[*] Fixed potential discrepancy on custom settings panel if original lobby host left
[*] Fixed some cases where items could be dropped inside bunker doors
[*] Fixed various environmental issues with the maps
[*] Fixed issue where dead animals could play their death animation again if the player takes a transport hatch and any are within range
[*] [Blackout] Fixed yeti receiving bonus objectives that can’t be completed

notes.title: Project Winter: Blackout
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, we’re happy to announce the first DLC pack for the game… Project Winter: Blackout. This action packed DLC will bring you everything you need just in time for the spookiest day of the year. This includes a brand new game mode with unique roles for THE traitor, a whole new map that incites even more fear and paranoia, new survivor roles and brand new items and weapons! Project Winter: Blackout is available for download on the Steam store for a price of USD 6.99. Checkout the trailer below.

[previewyoutube=1tCnsVgf68o;full][/previewyoutube]
[b][u]Key DLC Features[/u][/b]

[b]New Game Mode[/b]: A twist on the classic Traitor vs Survivors game mode, now there are the Demon and Whisperer roles for the traitor, yes THE traitor.  One traitor per game and this game mode focuses on converting survivors to your team.  The game is over once all survivors either escape, die or are converted. 

[b]New Traitor Roles[/b]: Play as either the Demon or the Whisperer. [list]
[*] [b]The Demon[/b]: Has the ability to forcefully convert survivors to the traitors team once they are in a downed state.
[*] [b]The Whisperer[/b]: slowly converts survivors by infiltrating their midst. 
[/list]

[b]New Map[/b]: A brand new map for Supernatural expansion games.  Explore a new, smaller, nighttime map with new special locations, interactable objects, and events.   

[b]New Survivor Roles[/b]: Unlock new Survivor Roles exclusive to the DLC.
[list]
[*] [b]Medium[/b]: You are able to see but not hear the ghost of any dead players around you. This is a passive ability and any ghosts that are within your range of vision will be automatically visible to you.
[*] [b]Hunter[/b]: You are immune to conversion and have a single use ability to reveal a role. Gain charge by gathering resources, looting crates or helping with objectives. Use your charged ability on a player, this will secretly reveal their role to you.
[*] [b]Padre[/b]: You have a single use ability to boost one other player. The chosen player will have a significant stat increase but beware! Using the ability on a traitor will give the traitor an even larger boost. Gain charge by looting crates and helping with objectives.
[*] [b]Yeti[/b]: As the Yeti, you are immune to conversion and are neither a Survivor nor a Traitor. You can side with either faction or be on your own. Complete your yeti task and escape with the Survivors or stay behind and help the Traitors get rid of the Survivors.
[/list]

[b]New Items[/b]: New Items can be used in the DLC!
[list]
[*] [b]Torch[/b]: Melee weapon that gives out a small circle of light and regenerates some warmth.
[*] [b]Rosary[/b]: Prevents conversion from traitors. Against the Whisperer, it absorbs conversion points, breaking at full capacity. Against the Demon, it repels one conversion attempt and revives from the knockdown, breaks after one use.
[*] [b]Holy Book[/b]: Melee weapon that is more effective towards animals during the Witching Hour event.
[*] [b]Gatling Stake Gun[/b]: Ranged weapon that is more effective towards animals during the Witching Hour event.
[*] [b]Flash Bang[/b]: Lights up the area and blinds the other players for a period of time.
[/list]

[b]Build Notes:[/b]

New pondering animation which plays while using the roles clipboard in the cabin, claiming a bonus objective or looting a corpse

[b]BUG FIXES:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed player not initially appearing as a survivor in the playable tutorial
[*] Fixed virtual cursor not appearing at end of tutorial for controller users
[*] Fixed player being able to get stuck in the escape cutscene if disembarking right as the countdown timer runs out
[*] Fixed case where other players could briefly see a player who took a traitor hatch at the wrong location, and the snow trail following them to the other hatch
[*] Fixed bunker crates not playing a sound when opened
[*] Fixed player being able to perform actions while playing an emote
[*] Fixed player being able to get stuck if playing emote right before falling
[*] Fixed next item in stack not being equipped if player is attacked while finishing deploying an item
[*] Fixed case where player could break if initiating a throw on the same frame as finishing a melee attack
[*] Fixed held item not being re-equipped if the hysteria event starts while the playing is interacting with an object
[*] Fixed players being freed from a bear trap being released too soon if they immediately trigger another bear trap
